source: [.]and where is Shigeki hiding?\p[.]\pIn plainer sight than any of his\nformer colleagues would believe.

label: @talk
source:
Mewtwo: If you wish to find
"The Catastrophe", [player][.]\pGo speak to Shigeki in Viridian
City.\pNow leave me to train for my next
worthy challenger.

label: @talk2
source:
Mewtwo: So you found "The
Catastrophe"[.]\pWell done, [player].
I'm impressed.\pBut I'm not ready to battle you
again yet.

label: @talk3
source: Mewtwo: [.][player].\c\h08ó\nWe meet again.\pYou've come a long way.

label: @talk4
source: I thought for sure he would come[.]\c\h08ó\nThat child[.]\pBut now I suppose he never will.\nYou'll do instead, [player].

label: @talk5
source:
I've lived a long life inside this
cave[.]\pPerhaps it's time I finally laid
down my guard[.]\pAnd allowed a worthy Trainer to
try his hand at catching me.

label: @talk6
source: You get one chance, [player].\pBut this time[.]\c\h08ó\nI'm not holding back!\pI'll never accept you as my master\nif you don't put up a fight!

label: @talk7
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nBrace yourself!

label: @talk
source: Yes, he knows where it is[.]\pThat disgusting failed experiment\nof a Pokémon Bill is after.

label: @talk2
source: If you truly wish to find it[.]\c\h08ó\nTo capture it at last[.]\pSpeak to Shigeki in Viridian City.\nHe will show you the way.

label: @talk3
source: That's all, [player]!\pLeave me now to train for my next\nworthy challenger.\p[.]\pI will see you again when you've\ngrown much stronger than you are.

label: @talk
source: What in the..?\pDo you think you can just waltz on\nin here and steal yourself one of\lour expertly, painstakingly\lcrafted top-grade Bicycles?

label: @no1
source: No? Oh, okay, then.\nCarry on.

label: @talk2
source:
Who do you think you are?\p[.]\c\h08ó
Oh, a Rocket, is that it?\pYou think it's cool, do you?\pYou think stealing the fruits of
other men's labor is cool?\pYou think that gluttonously taking
whatever your greedy hands can\lreach, without regard for the\lwell-being or the needs of this\lregion's people, let alone the\lprosperity of its fledgling\leconomy--is COOL?

label: @no2
source: Wha--\c\h08ó no, did you say?\nUm[.] why, that's exactly right.\pNot cool in the slightest.

label: @talk3
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
You!\pYou are the embodiment of
everything that is wrong with the\lworld!\pYou, immoral youngsters, walking
around like you own everything you\lsee, like everything is owed you\lby virtue of your having been\lborn!\pI fought in the war for your sort,
you know!\pDoes that give you something
worthwhile to think about, huh?

label: @yes3
source: Hmm? Yes..? I-it does?\nWahaha! I mean, I bet it does!\pWell, you go on home and you think\nabout that real good, now!

label: @talk4
source:
Gah!\pImpossible to get to through to
you with words, is it?\pWell, f-fine!
You asked for it, bandit!\pIf I could defend my region in
war, I can defend myself in\lbattle against crooks like you!

label: @defeat
source: Positively inconceivable!

label: @after
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
What has the world come to..?\pDisarmed[.] defeneseless[.]\pAt the hands of some pink-haired,
costume-wearing punk[.]\pNo..!\c\h08ó Hey, no! Please don't!\c\h08ó
I won't allow--\c\h08ó m-my Bicycles..!

source: [player] stole the Bicycle from the\nBike Shop!

label: @postStealTalk
source: You[.] fiend..!\nEvil[.] ungrateful[.] vile..!

source: The door is locked[.]

label: @CollectorTalk1
source: I-I don't even know what happened!\pI was just up on my regular hike\nup on Mt. Moon and I came back\ldown and all my hard-earned TMs\lwere gone!\pAnd here I'd gone and planned all\nyear to teach this here TM Dig to\lsome little Sandshrew or Mankey or\lwhat have you, and now it's all\lgone!

label: @CollectorTalk2
source: And then they dug this giant hole\nright through my wall-- I mean,\lthese crooks are Digging their way\linto no good, I say!

label: @fordTalk1
source: Ford: Truly an unnerving tale from\nthis poor homeowner.

label: @fordTalk2
source: Now, we understand that your\ndaughter here was out playing in\lthe vicinity when this incident\ltook place, and that she in fact\lwas witness to some of the actions\lof the criminals responsible.

label: @fordTalk3
source: Now, Miss: Would you mind\nexplaining to us exactly what you\lsaw?

label: @galTalk
source: Well, you know, I don't know\nexactly if it was the same people,\lbut there was this creepy guy who\ltried to rob me earlier!

label: @fordTalk4
source: Ford: Truly shocking!

label: @galTalk2
source:
Yeah, he was a real funny-looking
guy-- he had green hair and these\lweird black pajamas.\pHe had me fight him in a Pokémon
battle, and after he won he tried\lto steal my Pokémon!\pI wouldn't let him have them,
though, so then he just told me\lsomething about me being too old\land then ran off!\pI don't know where he went to
exactly, but I think I saw him\lwith some other guys wearing the\lsame funky outfit after!\pIt was really weird!

label: @fordTalk5
source: Ford: Now, Mr. Officer, I'm led to\nunderstand that, with the aid of\lthis young lady's description, the\lKanto police department has\lgotten rather a good idea of who\lmight be behind this crime?

label: @copTalk1
source: That's correct.\pThe variation in footprints as\nwell as the speed with which the\loperation was carried out make it\lclear that the burglary was\lcarried out by a larger group\lworking together.

label: @copTalk2
source: Furthermore, the uniforms\ndescribed by the witness leave\llittle doubt in our investigators'\lminds--\c\h08ó Team Rocket must be behind\lthis most heinous crime!

label: @fordTalk6
source: Ford: You heard it here first,\nviewers!\pThe Kanto police department\nbelieves, in other words, that\lthis burglary was an act of\lorganized crime by the notorious\lanti-government organization\lTeam Rocket!

label: @fordTalk7
source: Positively nerve-wracking!\pTo think that these wretched\ncriminals are currently on the\lloose, roaming the streets!\pViewers are advised to guard their\nhomes and their Pokémon!

label: @talk
source: This is Cerulean Cave.\pNobody enters without permission\nfrom the Pokémon Champion!\p[.]\pYeah, what..?\pLook, I don't care what fairy-\ntales you heard about what's\linside of here!\pRules are rules, buddy!

label: @talk2
source: H-hey!\nI said keep out, punk!

label: @defeat
source: You'll regret this!

label: @talk3

label: @talk
source: Only Trainers with an official\nlicense can collect Gym Badges.\pBums like you who battle without\none should be thrown in jail!

label: @talk
source: I concoct a variety of medicine\nfrom Berry Powder.\pIt's too bad you don't have any\nfriends to crush berries with!

label: @talk

label: @talk
source: My Pokémon seemed really tired\nafter coming back from the Day-\lCare Center.\pThat ungrateful little thing[.]\nIt cost me a lot of money, too!

label: @talk

label: @sign

You're one of those evil Rockets!\p[.]\pWell, if you've stolen any good
Pokémon, would you mind trading\lthem with my husband here?\pIt's one of the few things he
still finds any joy in doing.

label: @talk

label: @talk

label: @talk

label: @talk

according to plan[.]\pThe owner is still away, and

What's your name, scoundrel?\p[.]\c\h08ó
[player]?\pWell, let me check my registry

My, my, what have we here?
A Rocket bandit in the flesh!\pI'm to give you this TM36 Sludge

My goodness!\c\h08ó Y-you're one of the
most infamous criminals in Kanto!\pThe price on your head is a

label: @vBadText

Oh, my!
You're quite the villain!\pThe bounty on your head stands at

of your days in jail, I suggest\lyou change your ways soon, before\lit's all too late!

days, but you're on a dangerous\lpath, Rocket!\pThe bounty on your head stands at
[$][buffer1],000.\pCome back into the light while you
still can!

label: @mBadText
source: [blue_fr]What can I help you [blue_fr]with?

Well, you're not so bad, are you?\pThe bounty on your head is a mere
[$][buffer1],000.\pOh, a few slip-ups here and there
happen to the best of us, right?\pI'm glad you came to me to set
things straight again[.]\c\h08ó right?

label: @nBadText

label: @itemTalk

label: @notYetItem

label: @putAway

label: @itemAlreadyGot
source: Go seek out the officers in the\nother cities, son.\pIf you keep up your good behavior,\nthey'll reward you as I have!

label: @1pokeMsg

label: @handInTalk

Well, I'll be!

completely wiped.\pIt touches me to see that I could
help you become a free man again!

my moral principles, I assure you!\p[.]\c\h08ó

what can you do..?\p(Your bounty has been lowered to

Mmmm!\pWell, in times like these[.]
what can you do..?\p(The bounty on your head has now
been completely wiped.)\p(But I know nothing about it,
you hear me?)

label: @goodBye

What in Arceus's name is that
Pokémon..?!\pI don't know where you got that
from, but I'll want nothing to do\lwith it!\pHand in a normal Pokémon, won't
you?!

looking for you!\pDude. That was the most badass

Red.\pThe results of the genetic tests

label: @bossTalk1.5

source: Each member was a genius in his\nown right, and wasn't afraid to\lwork day and night for months for\la chance to save Kanto.

label: @bossTalk5

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc

source: Fuji suggested a way to contain\nMew's power within a solid,\lsentient body.

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc

label: @bossTalk16
source: Devoid of empathy, but\ndisturbingly intelligent, the\lnewborn clone could find no reason\lto fight for Kanto's cause.

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc
label: @bossTalk17
source: Why the war did not appeal to\nMewtwo we couldn't quite say[.]\pBut it refused to be used as a\nmilitary weapon.

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc

source: And when we insisted[.]\c\h08ó\nIt rebelled.

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc

"The Catastrophe"[.]\c\h08ó

file: scripts/flashback (faraway island + oak's lab + mansion)/pokemon mansion.rbc

label: @talk
source:
An inconspicuous old citizen of
Viridian City.\p[.]\pNotable to his neighbors only for
his frequent drunken bouts[.]\pAnd[.]\c\h08ó his habit of keenly showing
passerby youngsters how to catch\ltheir first Pokémon.

label: @flashOn
source: [player] switched on the\nFlashlight.

label: @lightText
source: It lit up the cave!

label: @noCaveText
source: [player] switched on the\nFlashlight.\p[.]\pBut it was not needed!

label: @onText
source: [.]\nBut the Flashlight is already on!

label: @talk
source:
Yo!
Rocket!\pI can see plainly what you are,
but I'm not gonna stop you.\pKoga's my boss, and he says he
needs a Rocket's help, so fine..!\p[.]\pBy the way, if you're going in to
talk business, the other Trainers\lwon't challenge you unprovoked.\pBut if you go up and talk to them,
they won't turn down a battle!

label: @talk
source: I guess[.] you were a good guy\nafter all..?

label: @guruTalk
source: You know, junior[.]\pYou've shaped up to be quite the\nable fisherman.\pHow proud I am, seeing you[.] with\nthat Rod clutched expertly in your\lhands[.] austere fish-catching\ldetemination in your eyes[.]\pIt's beyond description.

label: @guruTalk2
source: I think it's finally time[.]\c\h08ó I\nlet you in on our family secrets.

label: @sonTalk
source: Oh, gee, dad!\nWhat kind of secret is that?\pI promise I won't tell anyone!

label: @guruTalk3
source: The secret behind[.]\c\h08ó\nWhat makes our Rod so[.]\c\h08ó GOOD.\pWhy it will forever be the envy of\nmy younger brother.

label: @guruTalk4
source:
You see, junior[.]
It's really quite simple.\pThe handle of a Good Rod[.]\c\h08ó is one we
cultivate from the finest-grade\lIlex Forest wood[.]\pWe make the line from a special
type of extra-durable nylon[.]\pAnd then[.]\c\h08ó right at the point of
the hook[.]\pWe put just a little bit of[.]\c\h08ó
pharmaceutical grade cocaine,\lso that the fish.\c\h08ó.\c\h08ó.\c\h08ó

label: @guruTalk5
source: Junior!\c\h08ó It's another one of your\nuncle's spies, trying to eavesdrop\lon our best-kept fishing secrets!\pGet him!

label: @sonTalk2
source: I know how to deal with bad guys\nlike you!\pI won't let you ruin dad's\nfishing business!

label: @defeatText
source: Ah! I'm sorry I couldn't defend\nyou, pa!

label: @guruTalk6
source: I knew it! That devious brother\nof mine is sending crooks on me to\lsteal my secrets!\pArgh!\nI won't stand for it one minute..!

label: @guruTalk7
source:
L-look, man, I'm just a[.]\c\h08ó humble
entrepreneur[.]\c\h08ó trying to provide\lfor my only child.\pMy brother[.]\c\h08ó he lacks the skill
and imagination to make a decent\lRod himself[.]\pSo he tries to squeeze me out with
force instead!

label: @guruTalk8
source:
Th-the secrets you overheard[.]\pIf my brother finds out, he'll
have me bankrupt in no time!\pYou have a heart in there some-
where, don't you, bandit?\pCan you promise not to tell my
brother about my secrets?

label: @yesTalk
source:
Oh, my!
Thank you, spy!\pI don't have much to offer you in
return for daring to go against my\lbrother like that.\p[.]\pOur dealer gave me some of these,
but I can't find any use for them.\pMaybe you will?

label: @itemMsg
source: [player] received 3 Rare Candies!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put the Rare Candies in the\nItems pocket.

label: @noTalk
source:
(Sigh[.])\c\h08ó
I knew it..!\pIt's a dog-eat-dog world out
there, isn't it?\pWell, I hope my brother pays you
well for spying!\pC'mon, junior!

label: @talk
source:
I'm the Fishing Guru's older
brother.\pI simply looove fishing!
I can't bear to go without.\p[.]\pYou know, I usually give away a
promotional Rod to passers-by[.]\pBut you seem a bit shady; I think
that'd be a risky move.\pNothing personal, pal, just
business!

label: @talk2
source: You've done me a great service,\nspy.\pI'll make sure to let my youngest\nbrother know what you did!

label: @talk3
source: I will not have you inside my\nhouse, spy! Leave us!

label: @talk
source:
Sometimes, when I feel I'm taking
life a bit too seriously[.]\pI just stop to admire the dopey
look on a Slowpoke's face.\pThen I realize[.]
It's aaaall gooood, man.

label: @talk
source:
My father is the Gym Leader of
this town.\pHe always tells me you Rockets are
fighting for the good of Kanto.\lI think he's right.\pOh, but[.] I'm not supposed to tell
anybody about that, of course.

label: @talk
source:
Hehehehe!\pDid you ever try giving the old
man Warden a good scare?\pI like to sneak up behind him and
go "boo"! You should see his face!\p[.]\pThen I run on out and hide in the
bushes. Try it sometime!

label: @talk
source:
Our Gym Leader Koga is a respected
man around here.\pBut rumor has it he's on good
terms with those Rocket fellows!\pSuch a shame for a man like that,
isn't it?

label: @talk
source: I heard some funny-sounding gangs\nhave been causing trouble at\lCycling Road lately.

label: @talk
source:
Warden Slowpoke takes safety very
seriously.\pHe lets nobody enter his Safari
Zone without a proper ID.\pSo don't go thinking a thug like
you will get to play, Rocket!

label: @talk
source:
Warden Slowpoke is one shrewd
businessman!\pThe newest Safari Zone promotional
game is a real hit with customers.\pI hear Gym Leader Koga is not too
happy with it, though[.]

label: @talk
source: Warden Slowpoke has such a shiny,\nsparkly set of teeth, doesn't he?\pBut all it takes is a good shake\nand those dentures pop right out!\lIt's pretty funny, if you ask me.

label: @talk
source: That item ball in there[.]\nWere you wanting that?\pHaha, stupid! Have you never seen\na Voltorb before?

label: @postBattle
source: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pRemarkably intelligent for a\nRocket!

label: @text1
source: Fuchsia Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Koga\pWinning Trainers:

label: @text2
source: Fuchsia Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Koga\pWinning Trainers:\nMohammed Smith

label: @text3
source: Fuchsia Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Koga\pWinning Trainers:\nBlue, Red

label: @text4
source: Fuchsia Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Koga\pWinning Trainers:\nBlue, Red, Mohammed Smith

label: @talk
source:
Koga: Fwahahaha! Rocket!
The very type I need right now!\pI must request your assistance!
For ample compensation, of course.\pWarriors of the darkness, such as
you and I-- one in ninja robes and\lone in a jumpsuit of spandex!\pLet us unite our powers to a
common cause; what say you?

label: @talk2
source:
Very well!\c\h08ó
Here is my situation, young one.\pThe Safari Zone Warden runs
a promotion for his Safari Game.\pTrainers come in to play, and if
they reach his "Secret House",\lthey win an HM Surf[.]\pThe very move my Badge grants
them license to use, mind you!\pSee, the trouble is[.]\c\h08ó
Nobody's winning!\pThat old capitalist hid this House
out in some obscure corner that\lthese sorry Trainers never stand a\lchance of finding before the\lding-dong sound goes!

label: @talk3
source:
And what is the result, you ask?\p[.]\pThat nobody wants to challenge my
Gym anymore!\pIf they can't get that coveted HM
to Surf the seas, why, they see no\lreason to try for my Badge!\pPreposterous!\pI can hardly defend a Gym when it
has no cause for defending!

label: @talk4
source:
So, Rocket!\c\h08ó
Find that Secret House!\pSnatch yourself the largest box
full of HMs you can hold and\lbring it here!\pWe will set up our own method of
distribution.\pI have many ways to repay you for
your efforts, worry not.

label: @talk5
source: Now, as master of concealment and\ndisguise, I have tricks up my\lsleeve!\pTake this with you.

label: @cardReceive
source: [player] received the\nEmployee Card!

label: @talk6
source: Fwahahaha[.]\pUse that to sneak into the Safari\nZone without having to play that\lsilly Ball game.

label: @noTalk
source: Hmph!\nWell, suit yourself!\pIt's not as if a master ninja such\nas I has any trouble handling my\lown affairs! Be gone!

label: @midMissionTalk
source:
Koga: How goes it, fellow darkness
warrior?\pAre you on your way to getting me
a box of those HMs from the Secret\lHouse in the Safari Zone?\pFwahahaha[.]
Move with haste, Rocket!

label: @completeTalk
source: Koga: Oh my!\nYou brought it for me, Rocket!

label: @giveBox
source: [player] handed over the\nBox of HMs.

label: @completeTalk2
source: How can I repay you for such an\nact of service, Rocket?

label: @completeTalk3
source:
Fwahahaha!\c\h08ó
Why, I know just the thing!\pA tough-knuckled criminal like
yourself[.]\pI can provide you with[.]\c\h08ó
Your very own secret identity!\pOne that frees you from the judge-
ment and the hatred of the people!\pOne that[.]\c\h08ó could grant you entry
to any Gym like mine as any other\lofficial Trainer..!\pHow does such an arrangement
sound?\l[.]\pFwahahaha!\pThe master of concealment and
disguise has you covered, friend!\pTake this with you and use it
well.

label: @card2Receive
source: [player] received the\nTrainer Card!

label: @completeTalk4
source:
Fwahahaha[.]\pWith this masterfully crafted
Trainer Card of mine, you can\lchallenge any Gym Leader in Kanto!\pWhy[.]\c\h08ó
Even myself!\pOf course[.]\pPerhaps you should like to wait
until you have the rank and power\lin your underworld to steal a Gym\lLeader's Pokémon?\pFwahahaha[.]\c\h08ó
The choice is yours, Rocket!

label: @completeTalkBoss
source:
Fwahahaha[.]\pWith this masterfully crafted
Trainer Card of mine, you can\lchallenge any Gym Leader in Kanto!\pWhy[.]\c\h08ó
Even myself!\pI would think a tough-looking man
like you would have no trouble\lstealing a Pokémon or two from\lthem as well, eh?\pFwahahaha[.]

label: @postMissionTalk
source: Koga: Fwahahaha!\nWelcome back, Rocket!\pDid you come to challenge me to a\nGym battle?

label: @postMissionTalk2
source: Why, indeed!\pYou came simply to stare in awe at\nmy magnificent ninja skills?\pFwahahaha[.]\c\h08ó\nWho could blame you?

label: @challengeText
source:
Fwahahaha!\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
Poison-type Pokémon!\c\h0B[Ke]À

label: @rewardTalk
source: Now that you have the Soulbadge,\nthe Defense of your Pokémon rises.\pAh!\nTake this, too!

label: @makeSpace
source: Make space for this, Rocket!

label: @postDefeatTalk
source: Koga: What else is there to say,\nyoung Rocket?\pYou are a shadow warrior truly\nunlike any other!

label: @stolenTalk
source: Wah! A taste of my own medicine!\nYou sneaky thief, you!\p[.]\pWell, I never liked that\n[buffer1] much anyway, to tell\lyou the truth[.]\pAnyway[.]

label: @talk
source: My-my, what's this? Did the good\nTrainer change his mind? Haha!

label: @talk2
source:
Behold!
I have returned!\pLeto, aspiring master Cutter, at
your service!\pDo you wish me to Cut down all the
trees around Fuchsia?

label: @yesOrNo
source: A mere [$]1000, and you will bear\nwitness to my Cutting prowess!

label: @yesTalk
source: Ah! Sir, I daresay you made an\nexcellent choice!\pNow, if you'll allow me[.]

label: @noTalk
source:
No?\c\h08ó
Why, f-fine, then.\pI can see that this region is not
yet cultured enough to appreciate\lthe fine art of a proper Cut!\pWell, should the good sir ever
change his mind, I will never be\lfar away from any of this region's\lexquisite trees, rest assured!\pHmph! Good day.

label: @notEnoughTalk
source:
What?
Insufficient funds?\pSir, my asking price is akin to
giving it away, I assure you!\pBut[.] if the uncultured folk of
Kanto find it too great an expense\lfor witnessing the finest of fine\lart, then what is a man to do?\pWell, should the good sir ever
earn the necessary means to afford\lmy services, I will never be\lfar away from any of this region's\lexquisite trees, rest assured!\pHmph! Good day.

label: @goodBye
source:
Oh!
What pleasure..!\pA Cut as splendid as this is a
are sight in times like these,\leven to eyes such as mine!\pWell[.] should you ever be in need
of my Cutting expertise again,\ldear Trainer, you can be sure to\lfind me by this region's most\lbeautiful trees.\pUntil we meet again!

source: Do trees obscure the path to your\ndestiny? Do not fear, Trainer!

label: @talk
source: I am here, sir, and forever at\nyour service!\pThe one and only[.]\nLeto, master Cutter! \c\h08ó([.]almost.)

label: @talk2
source:
I Cut, dear Trainer, therefore I
am!\pWhere I see distraught travellers
undermined by trees in their path,\lmy giving heart fills with desire\lto set things right anew!\pLet me Cut for you the trees
around Fuchsia and ease the weight\loff your burdened shoulders!

label: @yesOrNo
source: [.]\c\h08ófor a modest fee of [$]1000,\nnaturally.

label: @introTalk
source: Uh[.]\nOh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.\pI can make Pokémon forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?

label: @whichPokemon
source: Which Pokémon should forget a\nmove?

label: @whichMove
source: Which move should be forgotten?

label: @confirmMove
source: Hm! [buffer1]'s [buffer2]?\nThat move should be forgotten?

label: @endTalk
source: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.

label: @eggTalk
source: What?\nNo Egg should know any moves.

label: @lastMoveTalk
source: [buffer1] seems to know only one\nmove[.]

label: @deleteTalk
source: It worked to perfection!\p[buffer1] has forgotten\n[buffer2] completely.

label: @missingnoTalk
source: W-what is that Pokémon..?!\nPlease don't make me touch it!\p[.]\pP-please bring me a normal Pokémon\ninstead, OK?

label: @introTalk
source: I'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.\pI know every single move that\nPokémon learn growing up.\pI'm also a capital maniac.\pBring me some cold, hard dough and\nI'll teach your Pokémon a move!

label: @moneyTalk
source: It's [$]3,000 a pop.\nHow about it, brother?

label: @noTalk
source: Hey, if your Pokémon need to learn\na move, I need compensation.

label: @whichPokemon
source: Which Pokémon needs tutoring?

label: @eggTalk
source: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an Egg.

label: @noMovesTalk
source: Sorry[.]\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that Pokémon.

label: @whichMove
source: Which move should I teach?

label: @notEnoughTalk
source: Ha, you poor loser!\nYou're not fooling me!\pGo get a job and get me some more\ndough before you see me again.

label: @1stTalk
source:
Well, well, well!\pIf it isn't one of you Rockets
I've heard so much about!\pI am a special officer, sent by
Lance to bring you to justice!\p[.]\pWha--\c\h08ó [.]no, I won't be arresting
you; those aren't my orders.\pI am here to "facilitate your
rehabilitation"!\pI have a shiny new TM26 Earthquake
right here, that can be yours if\lyou keep your criminal record\lclean long enough!

label: @1stTalk2
source:
Now, then[.]
What's your name, scoundrel?\p[.]\c\h08ó
[player]?\pWell, let me check my registry
here for a second[.]

label: @preItemTalk
source:
My, my, what have we here?
A Rocket bandit in the flesh!\pI'm to give you this TM26 Earth-
quake if you keep your record\lclean long enough, so keep it\lcool!\p[player], is it?\c\h08ó
Well, let me see here[.]

label: @postItemTalk
source: My, my, what have we here?\nA Rocket bandit in the flesh!\p[player], is it?\c\h08ó\nWell, let me see here[.]

label: @vBadTalk
source:
My goodness!\c\h08ó Y-you're one of the
most infamous criminals in Kanto!\pThe price on your head is a
whooping [$][buffer1],000!\pGrr[.] what could you possibly want
with me, you filthy outlaw?!\pIt will take a lot more than a
couple of Pokémon trades to atone\lfor your sins, I'll tell you!

label: @vBadText
source: [blue_fr][.]well?

label: @pBadTalk
source:
Oh, my!
You're quite the villain!\pThe bounty on your head stands at
[$][buffer1],000!\pThat's nothing to joke about, son.\pUnless you plan to spend the rest
of your days in jail, I suggest\lyou change your ways soon, before\lit's all too late!

label: @pBadText
source: [blue_fr]How can I help you t[blue_fr]urn things\n[blue_fr]around?

label: @mBadTalk
source:
Hm[.] Well, I've seen worse in my
days, but you're on a dangerous\lpath, Rocket!\pThe bounty on your head stands at
[$][buffer1],000.\pCome back into the light while you
still can!

label: @mBadText
source: [blue_fr]What can I help you [blue_fr]with?

label: @nBadTalk
source:
Well, you're not so bad, are you?\pThe bounty on your head is a mere
[$][buffer1],000.\pOh, a few slip-ups here and there
happen to the best of us, right?\pI'm glad you came to me to set
things straight again[.]\c\h08ó right?

label: @nBadText
source: [blue_fr]What can I do for yo[blue_fr]u, son?

label: @iTalk
source: Oh, wow! What's this? There's no\nbounty on your head at all!\pThat's what I like to see.\pThe moral road is a narrow one,\nbut you walk it all the same!

label: @itemTalk
source: I like you, son.\pHere is a token of appreciation\nfrom the government for embracing\lyour new life as a law-abiding\lcitizen!

label: @notYetItem
source: Keep up this behavior, and this TM\nwill be all yours before long.

label: @noRoomTalk
source: Why, but you've no space left for\nit, do you? Make some room!

label: @itemMsg
source: [player] received TM26 from the\npoliceman!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put TM26 in the TM Case.

label: @itemAlreadyGot
source: Go seek out the officers in the\nother cities, son.\pIf you keep up your good behavior,\nthey'll reward you as I have!

label: @1pokeMsg
source: But[.] surely you can't turn in\nyour only Pokémon?\pThat would cause all sorts of\nweird question marks and humbug.\pI'm not having it!

label: @handInTalk
source: Fair enough!\pYou hand in one of your stolen\nPokémon to me, and we agree to\llower the bounty on your head in\lproportion to the Pokémon's level.

label: @handInTalk1.5
source: The bounty on you is [$][buffer1],000.\nWhich Pokémon will you hand in?

label: @handInTalk2
source: Fine. I'll lower your bounty by\n[$][buffer1],000 for this [buffer2].

label: @pkmnDeleted
source: [player] turned [buffer2] in to the\npoliceman.

label: @postDeletion
source:
You made the right choice, Rocket.
Congratulations.\pYour bounty has now been lowered
to [$][buffer1],000.\pKeep it up and you'll be a free
man in no time at all!

label: @noMoreBounty
source:
Well, I'll be!
You did the right thing, Rocket.\pYour bounty has now been
completely wiped.\pIt touches me to see that I could
help you become a free man again!

label: @bribeTalk
source:
What's that?\c\h08ó
My god! The idea!\pI am unwavering in my adherence to
my moral principles, I assure you!\p[.]\c\h08ó
(Shh[.] not so loud, now.)

label: @howMuch
source: (How much are we talking?)\n(The bounty is [blue_fr]at [$][buffer1],000[blue_fr].)

label: @noMoneyTalk
source: Gah!\p(Come back when you actually have\nthe money, and we'll talk!)

label: @postBribeTalk
source:
Mmmm!\pWell, in times like these[.]
what can you do..?\p(Your bounty has been lowered to
[$][buffer1],000, all right?)\p(But remember, son-- I sure as
heck didn't do it!)

label: @postBribeTalk2
source:
Mmmm!\pWell, in times like these[.]
what can you do..?\p(The bounty on your head has now
been completely wiped.)\p(But I know nothing about it,
you hear me?)

label: @goodBye
source: No? Well, have it your way.\nGood day, Rocket.

label: @missingnoTalk
source:
What in Arceus's name is that
Pokémon..?!\pI don't know where you got that
from, but I'll want nothing to do\lwith it!\pHand in a normal Pokémon, won't
you?!

label: @talk
source: Looking good today, Mr. Smith!\pRemember, if you see any shady-\nlooking folks walking around\lthese parts, let me know!\pThe old Warden wants none of that,\nyou know! No, sur-rey!

label: @talk
source:
Old Warden Slowpoke is quite a
strict boss, gotta say.\pBut[.]\c\h08ó tell you something funny[.]\c\h08ó
He's real jumpy-like!\pI bet you could just sneak on up
behind the old guy and scare him\lright senseless!\pHa-ha!\c\h08ó Not that I'd ever have the
guts for a prank like that[.]

label: @guardTalk2
source: For just [$]500, you can play the\nSafari Ga--\c\h08ó\pHey[.]\c\h08ó I'll be darned if I haven't\nseen that uniform before..!

label: @guardTalk3
source: Warden Slowpoke said loud and\nclear-- "none of those Rocket\lfolks in our Safari Zone"!\pBad for business, you see.\nYou're gonna have to leave, pal.

label: @guardTalk4
source:
Wait[.]\c\h08ó What's that you got there?
Oh, it's one of our employee IDs!\p[.]\pSo you're just passing through to
feed the Pokémon or something, eh?\p[.]\pYou know, I've[.]\c\h08ó never seen your
face here before, have I?\lAnd that uniform you've got[.]\pSay, let me just call the Warden
to make sure nothing fishy's going\lon[.]\pDon't mean to be paranoid, it's
just procedure. Hang on a sec.

label: @guardTalk5
source: Yeah, Warden, is it?\pNothing much to bother you, sir,\nsee[.]\c\h08ó I was just wondering[.]\pDo we have a[.]\c\h08ó er--\c\h08ó a[.]\pPink-haired young dude with a[.]\c\h08ó\npajama-looking outfit[.]\lRed "R" across his chest[.]\lName of[.]\l"Mohammed Smith"[.]\l..working here at the Safari Zone?

label: @wardenTalk
source:
Warden: Argh!\c\h08ó You useless idiot!
Don't you see?!\pIt's one of those Rocket goons
trying to sneak their way in!\pDo not let that thug into my
Safari Zone for any reason!

label: @guardTalk6
source:
Thought you could fool me, did
you, Rocket?\pHah! I could see you were a
criminal from miles away!\pGo bother someone else, why don't
you? No place for your sort here!

label: @guardTalk7
source:
Er[.]\c\h08ó
Look, Warden, sir, I[.]\lCan't hear a word you're saying[.]\lCould you[.]\c\h08ó speak a bit clearer..?\p[.]\c\h08ó
..what?\pI can tell you're getting worked
up, boss, but[.]\c\h08ó I can't[.]\p[.]\p(Sigh[.])\c\h08ó
This isn't working[.]

label: @guardTalk8
source:
Look, I can't understand a word
that old senile is saying today[.]\pYou know[.]\pYou seem legit enough to me, pal.\c\h08ó
Come on through.\pMake sure those Chansey stay extra
fat, eh?\c\h08ó Ha-ha-ha[.]

label: @talk
source: Hey, aren't you a Roc--\p[.]\pOh, I'm sorry!\nI didn't realize you work here.

label: @talk
source: I'm starting to wonder if there\neven is a "Secret House".\pI sure can't find it.\nAdvertising fraud, is what it is!

label: @talk
source: I came across a shiny Chansey, but\nit fled.\pDo you think I'm justified in\nkilling myself..?

label: @talk
source: I don't know about you, but I\nreally get off on throwing rocks\lin wild Pokémon's faces.\pDon't know what it is[.]

label: @talk
source: I'm not leaving this place until I\ncatch a Chansey, damn it!

label: @talk
source: Congratulations!\nYou reached the Secret House!\pIn accordance with our campaign\nrules, you get a fabulous prize!

label: @talk2
source:
You know what this wonderful prize
is, don't you?\pIt's HM03, the hidden machine that
can carry you across the seas--\c\h08ó\p[.]\pNo, no..!\c\h08ó
Only one HM per contestant.\p[.]\pH-hey..!\c\h08ó I said only one!\lIt's the rules, okay?\p[.]\c\h08ó
I-I can't[.]\p[.]\pAll right, h-have it your way..!\pThe Warden said not go easy on
cheaters, so you asked for it!

label: @defeatText
source: Oh no[.] The Warden will have my\nhead for this[.]

label: @talk3
source:
You cheating, disrespecting
little[.]\p[.]\c\h08ó
Oh, darn it all.\pWhy did it have to be me that got
the bandit..?

label: @boxGet
source: [player] stole the Box of HMs from\nthe Secret House!

label: @talk4
source:
I bet you're real happy now,
aren't you?\pFor Chrissakes[.] what could you
possibly need the entire box for?\pHMs don't break after one use, you
know[.]

label: @talk
source:
Heeeeeeey, man[.]\c\h08ó
Dude, I'm looking for some gold.\pGold is so[.]\c\h08ó sparkly, nice[.]\c\h08ó
Just like your soul, man[.]\pHave you got anything golden?\c\h08ó
Maaaaaan[.]\c\h08ó I'll suck yo--\p[.]\pI mean, I'll pay anything you
want, man!

label: @talk2
source: Oh, dude! Those teeth you got\nthere, man!\pSooooo shiny[.]\c\h08ó sparkly[.]\c\h08ó\nSo nice[.]

label: @talk3
source: Sell them to me, man!\n[$]5,000, cold cash, no jokes!

label: @noTalk
source: But maaaaan[.]\c\h08ó\nI[.] I need that stuff, man!\pYou can't just stand there and\nlook at my gold cravings, man..!

label: @yesTalk
source: YES, YES, YES!\c\h08ó\nGold, god damn it!\c\h08ó GOLD!\pAhahahahahahaha!\c\h08ó\nFinally, it's within my grasp[.]

label: @postSaleTalk
source:
Oh, man[.] It's so niiiiiiice[.]\p[.]\pNothing in the world can make me
lose this gold, you know[.]\pNot even if some scary-looking
little kid Trainer should stop by\land make me run away scared[.]\pNo, never! Me and my precious
shall never part[.]

label: @pop
source: The Warden's teeth popped out of\nhis mouth!

label: @caughtTalk
source: Warden: What do you want, kid?\p[.]\pHey, you're one of those Rocket\npunks from the TV!\pScram! I want no association\nbetween you and my Safari game!

label: @talk
source: Damn it! I came all this way to be\na challenger.\pBut how can anyone compete with\nchild prodigies like these?\pThe world just isn't fair[.]

label: @talk
source: Holy Miltank!\pWhat do they feed their kids down\nthere in Pallet Town?

label: @talk
source: Lance has been my hero since he\nwon the war all that time ago.\pI still don't believe it[.]

label: @talk
source: So that's how quickly the region\ncan be taken over by an eleven-\lyear-old.\pI suppose no one anticipated this\nin the constitution?

label: @talk
source: Damn[.] two all-powerful challengers\nin such short time!\pAnd minors, too!\pMakes me think I should've\naccomplished more in life by now[.]

label: @talk
source: I[.] um[.]\nHave no strategies to offer!\pIf these two kids can get this\nfar, all my battle theories go out\lthe window!

label: @talk
source: I was planning to be a challenger,\nbut then I faced that Red kid in\lVictory Road.\pLooks like I've got a few more\ndecades of training to do[.]

label: @talk
source: Hoo-ah!\pI am now adapting my training\nstyle after Red and Blue!\pI was wrong to study Bruno all\nthese years..!

label: @talk
source: I've never heard that Red kid say\nanything other than battle\lcommands to his Pokémon.\pHow awkward would it be to have a\nmute Champion? Let's hope not.

label: @talk
source:
Smell ya later, you stinker!\p[.]
Haha[.]\pI'm adopting the new Champion's
catchphrases.\pHe'll definitely be a hot trend-
setter from now on.

label: @billTalk
source: [player]!\c\h08ó\nOh, thank Arceus[.]

label: @billTalk2
source:
Bill: I came as soon as I could[.]\c\h08ó
Damn it!\pI tried to outrun that geezer Oak,
but I'm afraid I might have been\ltoo late[.]\pThe clock is ticking now.
We have to stop this quickly!

label: @billTalk3
source: Look, [player].\c\h08ó\nI've seen the basement lab[.]\pI know about the kid, I know\neverything.

label: @billTalk4
source:
Now he's got his Badges and he's
heading off to fight the Elite Four.\pWell, we both know he's going to
have no trouble with them.\pThen the moment he's Champion, Oak
will swoop in and make sure he has\lcomplete political control[.]

label: @billTalk5
source:
Lance was just defeated and the
public's in a frenzy[.]\pEverybody's watching[.]\c\h08ó
Agh!\p[.]\pThe only part of this I can't seem
to wrap my head around is[.]\pWho the hell is Blue?\c\h08ó
Anyway, no matter.

label: @billTalk6
source: Hey, gym guy!\pWhat's the name of the challenger\nwho came in earlier?

label: @clydeTalk
source: Some kid Red from Pallet Town.\nCan't mistake him.\pI heard he might be coming.\nSounds like a beast, man.

label: @billTalk7
source: Bill: ..!

label: @billTalk8
source: Well, there's nothing left to\nspeculate about, [player].\lIt's going down.\pWe have to get in[.]\c\h08ó\nWe have to move!

label: @talk
source: Bill: What are you talking about,\n"challengers only"?\pYou just let that psychopath of a\nProfessor in, didn't you?!\pThis is important, woman!

label: @talk2
source:
It's no use, [player]..!\c\h08ó
We've got to get in somehow!\pLook, whatever dirty tricks you
have up your sleeve, or violent\lbrutes you can call up[.]\pIf there was ever a time we'd need
them, it's now!

label: @2talk1
source:
Bill: Well[.]\c\h08ó
This is it, [player]!\pI don't know what's going to
happen when we go through those\ldoors behind me[.]\pBut I think it's safe to say you
might face some of the toughest\lbattles of your life.

label: @2talk2
source: So[.]\c\h08ó\nMake sure you're ready.\pIf you have preparations to make[.]\c\h08ó\nMake them now!

label: @2talk3
source: I would strongly urge you to bring\nMissingNo. along as well.\pYou're going to need it.

label: @2talk4
source: With that out of the way[.]\c\h08ó\nAre you ready, [player]?

label: @entryTalk
source: Here we go, then.\c\h08ó\n[.]I've said my prayers already.

label: @noTalk
source: Then get on with it, quick!\nRed won't wait for us!

label: @questionTalk
source: Bill: Well!\nAll set, [player]?

label: @noMissingnoTalk
source: If you have preparations to make[.]\c\h08ó\nMake them now!\pI would strongly urge you to bring\nMissingNo. along as well.\pYou're going to need it.

label: @talk
source: Sorry, sir!\pThe Elite Four are currently\nengaged with another challenger.\pYou'll have to wait your turn with\neveryone else.

label: @talk2
source:
Now!
We have rules for a reason, sir!\pThe Elite Four shall not be disturbed
in the middle of a battle!\pThe Professor is perfectly entitled
to see to his grandson's health,\lthat's another matter.\pJust be patient and you'll hear
the outcome with everyone else.

label: @talk3
source: No, no, no!\pWe're not taking any more\nchallengers right now!\pAnd especially not you!\p[.]\pMaybe[.]\c\h08ó sometime[.]\c\h08ó\nSomewhere down the line.\pWho knows..?

label: @ronnieTalk1
source: Ronnie: Raticate!\c\h08ó\nGive us a Hyper Fang!

label: @billTalk1
source: Bill: [.]\c\h08ó\nWell[.] that works.

label: @ronnieTalk2
source: Ronnie: Don't worry, [player]!\pMe and Raticate will stand guard\nhere and keep nosy people out.\pYou go do what you've got to do!

label: @text
source: Bill's words echoed[.]\p"I would strongly urge you to\nbring MissingNo. along as well.\pYou're going to need it."

label: @tvTalk
source:
Announcer: Exciting changes in
store for the region!\pChampion Blue's new Elite Four have
since made preparations to meet the\lmysterious new Challenger.\pWe'll bring you more news as it
comes.

label: @ronnieTalk
source: Ronnie: Can you believe it,\n[player]?\pThat spiky-haired little twerp!\c\h08ó\nWhat a gas!

label: @oakTalk
source: Oak: So it's true then.\c\h08ó\nI don't believe it[.]

label: @oakTalk2
source: Blue..?\c\h08ó\nIt's[.]\c\h08ó not possible[.]

label: @oakTalk3
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nHere, guard! Let me through!

label: @oakTalk4
source: I'm the new Champion's grandfather,\nand I demand to see him!\pThis is an urgent matter!

label: @talk
source:
Hello, [player]!
Good lord, it's been a while[.]\p[.]\c\h08ó
Hey, don't you recognize me?\pStupid old dingbat!\c\h08ó [.]It's me!\c\h08ó
Ronnie!\pMan, I'll tell you!\pIt's been tough since Team Rocket[.]\c\h08ó
Being a solo gangster and all.\pI've robbed a couple of Youngsters
and schoolgirls and things, but\lit's just not the same anymore[.]

label: @talk2
source:
Well, but look at you, Mr. Posh!\pI suppose the hair gel comes with
the promotion, does it?\pI always thought you were a little
camp, but this takes the cake!\pHahaha[.]\c\h08ó
Anyway[.]

label: @talk3
source:
These are mad times, [player]!\c\h08ó
Have you heard the news?\pLance is done for! Defeated!\c\h08ó
Hahaha[.] and guess what?\pSomeone's just gone in to challenge
the new Elite Four already!\pOh, oh!\c\h08ó But here's the best part!\c\h08ó
Guess who the new Champion is..?\pHere, just wait, it's gonna be on
TV any second now[.]

label: @TVtalk
source:
Announcer: It's a historic day for
Kanto-Johto, ladies and gentlemen!\pChampion Lance has been defeated
in Pokémon League battle by a\lyoung challenger from Pallet Town!\pWe spoke to the region's remarkable
new adolescent Champion shortly\lafter his victory.

label: @postBillTalk
source: Ronnie: Who was that nerdy guy,\n[player]? Friend of yours?

label: @postOakTalk
source:
Ronnie: Who would've thought that
back at Mt. Moon, eh?\p[.]\pHmm..?\c\h08ó
Prof. Oak was here just now?\pHey, calm down, [player]!\pWhy should we care about that old
fart anymore..?

label: @postKnockoutTalk
source: Ronnie: We've come a long way,\nhaven't we, [player]?\pYou go handle what you need to now.\nI've got your back.

label: @postBlockTalk
source: Ronnie: Hey, what's all this\ncommotion, [player]?\pAre you guys trying to break in\nto the Elite Four? That's rad!

label: @postBlockTalk2
source: [.]\pWhat's that, you need help?\p[.]\c\h08ó\nWhat?\c\h08ó You mean[.]\c\h08ó my help..?

label: @postBlockTalk3
source: Damn[.]\c\h08ó\n[.]I never thought you'd say that.

label: @postBlockTalk4
source:
You know, [player], I[.]\pI know I haven't been the greatest
buddy in the world.\pI keep getting things wrong and
screwing stuff up.\pI know I'm not as smart as you
and all[.]

label: @postBlockTalk5
source: I just[.]\c\h08ó wanted to be bad.\pA real badass pimp gangster, right?\c\h08ó\nThe whole nine yards.\p[.]\pI didn't want to wait around.\pDidn't want anyone to think I was\na sissy. I couldn't take it.

label: @postBlockTalk6
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
I'm real sorry.\pI'm going to set things straight and
be a proper thief like you one day.\pI'll do things by the plan.\c\h08ó
No more cutting corners.

label: @postBlockTalk7
source: So look!\c\h08ó\nJust this once[.]\pLeave it to me, [player]!\nFor old time's sake.

label: @postBlockTalk8
source: Raticate!

label: @postBlockTalk9
source: On alert, you lazy rat!\c\h08ó\n[.]we've got work to do.

label: @talk
source: Hey, if Pokémon Centers are free,\nwhy you gotta pay for Potions?\pThat's what I wanna know!

label: @talk
source: I mean, he used Double Team,\nThunder Wave and Attract in the\lsame match!\pHow the hell was I supposed to\ncontain myself in that situation?!

label: @talk
source: C'mon, man[.]\nIf you had a Gardevoir like mine[.]\pYou'd have done it too!

label: @talk
source:
Well, you!\c\h08ó
Today's your lucky day.\pNever knew you had such rich
friends lying around.\pIt ain't right if you ask me!\p[.]\pBut I gotta go by what the law
says.\pHere we go[.]

label: @shigekiTalk
source: [player]!\c\h08ó\nI see you're still around.\p[.]\pDon't you recognize me?\c\h08ó\nIt's me, Shigeki!

label: @shigekiTalk2
source: I'm bailing you out, young man.\pAfter what you did for me[.]\c\h08ó\nWith "The Catastrophe"[.]\pIt's the least I could do.

label: @bountyTalk
source: But[.]\pThe bounty that was on your head[.]\c\h08ó\n[$][buffer1],000[.]

label: @bountyTalk2
source: You've got to contribute what you\ncan, or I'll have nothing left to\lfeed myself.

label: @talk2
source: All right, you worthless crook!\c\h08ó\n[.]You're free to go.

label: @postReleaseTalk
source: Gah!\pIf it were up to me, you'd be in\nfor life, Rocket!

label: @talk
source: If you get up to anything funny\nonce you're out[.]\pWe'll send you right back in!\nCount on it!

label: @talk
source: Hmph! You're not rehabilitated in\nmy eyes, Rocket!

label: @talk
source: Do as you're told, Rocket!\nDon't push your luck!

label: @talk
source:
Blue: Are you superstitious at
all, Mr. Rocket?\pSee, grandpa always told me
everything in the world has a\lrational explanation.\pBut[.] this place[.] I really don't
know what to make of it.\pAll these channelers are acting so
weird, and[.] well, they've got\lthis "purified protected zone"\lupstairs[.]\pThey tell me it's sealed by white
magic, a-and when I stepped on it,\lI could feel my body just[.]\lrelaxing[.] letting go.\pI don't know what to believe
anymore.\pMaybe the world isn't as clear-cut
as my grandpa always said[.]

label: @talk
source: Blue: Well, you ready?\nWe're almost there.

label: @talk2
source:
[.]\pI can sense something ominous by
that staircase over there.\pI don't know what it is, but[.]\c\h08ó
I'm not scared!\pI'll face it if you will,
Mr. Rocket.

label: @2talk
source: Come on, Mr. Rocket, let's do it!\nYou're not scared, are you?

label: @talk
source:
Blue: Well, this wasn't very
exciting.\pThere's just some old guy up here!
No rare Pokémon or items!\p[.]\pWhat? Oh, you're here to see the
old man, are you?

label: @talk
source: Blue: I hope I'll see you again\nsometime, Mr. Rocket.

label: @heyYou
source: Blue: Hey, you!

label: @heyYou
source: Blue: Hey, you!

label: @talk
source:
What are you looking at? Go mind
your own dead Pokémon, I say!\pOh, you're the Rocket from before,
aren't you?\pWhat?
Want a piece of me, pal?\pI'll have you know I'm way
stronger than I was back on Nugget\lBridge, you can bet on it!\pI'll take you on, right here,
right now! Bring it!

label: @talk2
source: Ah[.]\c\h08ó what's the use?

label: @talk3
source: I really don't want to battle you\nright now, okay? It's a bad time.

label: @talk4
source: Do you want to know why I came\nhere, Rocket?\pBecause my Pokémon died.\nThat's why.

label: @talk5
source: See, there's this guy I know from\nPallet Town, where I grew up.\pHis name's Red.\pA lot of grown-ups think he's\namazing, but he's a bit of a\lloser, really.

label: @talk5.5
source: Anyway, we became Pokémon Trainers\nat the same time, you see, and we\lbattle each other now and again.

label: @talk6
source:
Just a little while ago I fought
him aboard the S.S. Anne in\lVermilion.\pHe beat me-- he always does, to
tell you the truth.\pBut, see, this time was
different[.]\pRed hurt my Raticate really bad in
that battle-- \c\h08óreally bad.

label: @talk7
source: It was weeping and bleeding all\nover-- I mean, I could barely get\lit into its Poké Ball!\pSo I rushed out to get it to the\nPokémon Center as soon as I\lcould, but there was all this\lcommotion going on aboard the\lship, and I kept losing my way,\land taking all this time, and[.]

label: @talk8
source: He's a murderer, you know.\c\h08ó\nA stinker, a loser and a murderer.\pI hate Red-- I hate his guts, and\nI always have!

label: @talk9
source:
Do you know Prof. Oak?\pYeah, he's my grandfather, but you
sure wouldn't think so!\pHe's the one who licensed me and
Red to become Pokémon Trainers.\pAnd let me tell you, ever since
I was little, way before we were\leven Trainers, he always did like\lRed so much better than he ever\ldid me!

label: @talk10
source: Everything I did, all the things I\naccomplished, and no matter how\lstrong I got[.] grandpa always\lseemed to think Red somehow did it\lbetter.\pLike Red's some special snowflake\nprodigy and I'm just[.] nobody.

label: @talk11
source:
[.]\pI called him, you know. Grandpa.
Right after it happened.\pTold him about how I couldn't save
Raticate, and how sad I was.\pAnd do you know what he told me?\p"Oh, that's too bad, son.\pHow about you catch a new one, a
stronger one instead?"

label: @talk12
source:
He doesn't care about me one bit!\p[.]\pBut do you want to know another
thing? I'm over it now.\pI'm done being Red's runner-up.
It's over.\pI've decided:\c\h08ó\I'm going to be the
Pokémon Champion!\pI don't care what or how long it's
going to take, because that's what\lI'm going to do!

label: @talk13
source:
And when I stand atop the Indigo
Plateau as the strongest Trainer\lin all of Kanto[.]\pGrandpa will finally see that he
was wrong about me all this time.\p[.]And nobody will care about Red
and his stupid accomplishments\lanymore!

label: @talk14
source:
You know[.] you're alright,
Mr. Rocket man.\pGrandpa always told me to be
cautious around you people, but I\ldon't think you're all bad.\pYou seem like the good, quiet,
listening type at least.\pThanks for hearing me out.

label: @talk15
source:
You going up top?\c\h08ó
How about we tag along?\pI was unsure before if I had the
guts to climb all the way, what\lwith the ghosts up there and all.\pBut now[.]\c\h08ó now there's nothing in
the world that can scare me.\pI'll take anything at all!

label: @talk16
source: I'll see you around, Mr. Rocket!

label: @talk2
source: That old man[.]\nWas that Samuel Oak?\pWhy did he leave in such a hurry?\nI've always wanted to meet him[.]

label: @talk
source: Argh! No!\nHave you returned?\pWe were so happy when we thought\nyou Rockets had finally left our\ltown for good[.]

label: @talk
source:
The ghosts that now plague our
Pokémon Tower[.]\pThey're all your fault, aren't
they, Rocket?\pJust wait till Mr. Fuji gets his
hands on you! He'll make you pay!

label: @talk
source: Waaaah!\nWhat do you want?\pLeave us alone, Rocket!\pHaven't you wreaked enough havoc\nin this town already?

label: @talk
source: Nooo! Please don't kill any more\nof our Pokémon!

label: @talk
source: You people will do anything for the\nsake of money, won't you?\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!

label: @talk
source: You people killed that poor\nCubone's mother!\pIf I had my way[.] you wouldn't get\nto heal your Pokémon here!

label: @talk
source: Someday, Lance is going to come\nhere and throw you all in jail!\pTh-that's what Mr. Fuji said..!

label: @talk

There's a fatal flaw in the logic
underlying the Mewtwo Project.\pYes[.]\c\h08ó there is immense potential
in genetic engineering, no doubt.\pAnd we've correctly isolated the
genes responsible for aggression\land sociopathy.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 2/video diaries 2-3 level script.rbc
label: @talk2
source: But what good are they[.]\pIn the body of a Pokémon that\ncannot be reasoned with?

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 2/video diaries 2-3 level script.rbc
label: @talk3
source: The wartime chaos makes people\nfocus on raw muscle power to the\lexclusion of everything else.\pThey forget that we are not\nsavages.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 2/video diaries 2-3 level script.rbc
label: @2talk
source: Why have Pokémon grown to be such\na dominating force in society?

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 2/video diaries 2-3 level script.rbc
label: @2talk2
source:
Not by their individual power
alone.\pLeft to their own devices, Pokémon
are passive, simple-minded\lcreatures.\pAbove all, the thing that
determines the strength of a\lpack of Pokémon[.]

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 2/video diaries 2-3 level script.rbc
label: @2talk3
source: Is the intelligence, the\ndiscipline and the leadership[.]\pOf the humans that control them.\pA Pokémon is only as strong as its\nmaster.

label: @talk3

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 3/video diaries 4-5 level script.rbc
label: @talk4
source: Coldly and objectively he could\ndevise his battle strategies, push\lhis Pokémon to their limits[.]\pLike a dispassionate puppet master,\ndirectly controlling the actions\lof his Pokémon from afar[.]\pAs if by the click of a button[.]

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 3/video diaries 4-5 level script.rbc
label: @talk5
source: Fuji and Shigeki have taught me\nall I need.\pI will create this superhuman\nTrainer on my own.\pAnd nobody is to know.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 3/video diaries 4-5 level script.rbc
label: @2talk
source: Initial tests appear promising[.]\pBut I cannot recreate the body of\na full-grown, living boy of\lbattling age.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 3/video diaries 4-5 level script.rbc
label: @2talk2
source: For the clone to resemble a human\nwell enough to fool the world[.]\pI will create my master Trainer as\nan embryo and let nature take its\lcourse.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 3/video diaries 4-5 level script.rbc
label: @2talk3
source: A sterile local widow, blindly\ndevoted to me since our youth,\lwill happily agree to adopt him as\lhis mother.

label: @2talk4

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @talk3

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @talk4
source: They'll never see a child like\nthis coming.\pThey won't believe their eyes.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @2talk
source:
Mewtwo escaped the Pokémon Mansion
and put an end to that farcical\lproject.\pKanto's military resources are
running out[.]\pWe can't afford this war any
longer.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @2talk2
source: Lance will not give in until he\nhas my head on a pike and all of\lKanto kneeling before him[.]

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @2talk3
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nIt won't do.\pI will surrender my position as\nChampion.

file: scripts/oaks secret lab/room 4/video diaries 6-7 level script.rbc
label: @2talk4
source: Lance will gleefully take my place,\nand the public will shame me as a\lcoward and a traitor[.]\pBut they will let me live.

label: @2talk5

label: @2talk6

label: @2talk7

label: @2talk8

label: @billTalk2

A long time ago, we were a tight-
knit couple, Oak and I.\pSamuel was a man of honor[.]
back in those days.\pHe valued strength, vigilance and
purpose, and he embodied it.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk4
source: We raised a son together, in the\nimage of those principles.\pHe turned out a great man, and\nblessed us with two grandchildren\lto carry our values forward.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk5
source:
But no sooner than Blue, their
youngest, had been born[.]\pThe war struck our family.\pDaisy and Blue both survived
unscathed, but[.]\pOur son and his wife both perished
in the madness.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk6
source: [.]\pAnd Samuel and I, we swore[.]\c\h08ó\nThat we would avenge them.\pWe would bring down Lance and\nmake him pay for taking away our\linnocent children.

Would you believe it?\pHe swore it to me!
He gave his word, [player].\p[.]\pAnd then[.] Why, just a little
while later[.]\pHe committed the most heinous,
cowardly, shameful act I ever saw.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc

source: The soft, spineless fool that\nsurrendered to Lance is not the\lman I loved.\pEven if he didn't stand a chance[.]\pEven if sticking it out, fighting\nfor something he believed in,\lwould have ultimately meant his\ldeath[.]

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk10
source: At least it would have been an\nhonorable one!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @daisyTalk
source: Daisy: Grandma, please..!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ellipses
source: Agatha: [.]

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk11
source: I'm sorry, Daisy.\c\h08ó\nFor going there again.\pYou know how I can I get\nsometimes.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk12
source: I had better get going, darling.\nAlways work to be done.\pDo take care of yourself and send\nregards to your brother.\pYou're such lovely kids.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @agathaTalk13
source:
I can't say I approve of what you
and your boss are doing around\lKanto, [player].\pBut I can't say I[.]\c\h08ó don't
sympathize with your frustration.\pNot quite respect, but[.]\c\h08ó
understanding.\pUntil we meet again.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @daisyTalk2
source:
Daisy: [.]\c\h08ó
You know, I[.]\pDon't think grandpa is really a
bad person.\pHe's really very cheerful and
friendly-- the way they show him\lin the papers.\pHe gave me and Blue a happy
childhood, and I'm grateful.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @daisyTalk3
source: But[.]\c\h08ó\nYou know[.]\pThere's just this one thing that\nalways bothered me[.]

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk1
source: Geez!\c\h08ó There you are, [player]!\nWhat's the holdup, dude?

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk2
source:
Ronnie: Why, I've been looking all
over for you!\pSorry to interrupt the friendly
tea party and all, but yo!\pWe got a Pokémon Professor to
interrogate!\pLet's go hand it to that old man
Oak-- you got me tired waiting!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @daisyTalk4
source: Daisy: Oh, no!\c\h08ó Is it true?\nYou disgusting thug!\pGrandma was wrong to trust a\nRocket for company-- I knew I\lshould never have allowed it!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk3
source: Ronnie: Gee, [player], you sure\nfixed yourself a feisty date, huh?\pWell, no time for that now! We\ngotta hit up this lab, pronto!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @daisyTalk5
source: Daisy: In all my days..!\c\h08ó\nYou're not going anywhere!\pI won't let any low-life thugs\ntrespass on our home and family!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @defeatText
source: I[.] I won't accept it!\nGet out of our house!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk6
source: Ronnie: Phew! Well done, [player].\nQuite the energy in this one, eh?\pLeave it to me now-- stand back.

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk7
source: Ronnie: Raticate!\c\h08ó\nHyper Fang, go!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk8
source:
Well, good riddance!\pPokémon that strong on an
unassuming girl like that[.]\pShe's got some rich family or
other, I'll bet my kidney!\pRaticate, see if you can't find
any valuables around here to loot!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk8.5
source:
[.]\p[.]huh?\c\h08ó
What's the matter, [player]?\pWhy, you look like you ain't
ever seen a Rocket in action!\pHaha!\c\h08ó
You little sissy, you!\pI bet a good interrogation should
wake you right up again, eh?

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk9
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
Huh, what, now?\pYou checked the lab, and[.]\c\h08ó
The old guy's not even here?\pWell, gee, talk about a big fat
waste if I ever saw one!

file: scripts/pallet town/blue's house/agatha & daisy tea scene.rbc
label: @ronnieTalk10
source:
Well, it's a good thing we got in
a bit of action just now, then!\pIt's not a good day without
at least one robbery, am I right?\p(Sigh[.])\c\h08ó I guess we might as well
just head back to HQ.

label: @talk
source: Ronnie: Well[.] can't win 'em all,\ncan we, [player]?\pNothing much more we can do but\nhead on back to HQ, is there?

label: @talk
source:
Daisy: Yes, how can I help you?\pYou're dressed way too bizarre to
be from around here[.]\p[.]
I'm Blue's sister, that's right.\pHe's a nice boy, and he's growing
to be a strong Trainer.\pBut[.] I don't see why it matters
to you?

label: @talk2
source: Daisy: [.]you!\pLeave this innocent town this\nminute or I'll call the police!\pThe scratches from your companion's\nugly rat still haven't healed,\lI'll have you know!

label: @talk
source:
Ohhh! You're one of those R-people
from the city my ma told me about!\pYou guys are some real trouble-
makers, aren't ya?\pI never thought I'd see one of you
for real[.]\p[.]\pCan you commit a crime here maybe?
Oh, it would be so exciting!

label: @talk2
source: Oh, oh, oh!\pAll that commotion from Blue's\nhouse! Was it you, R-man?\pHow exciting! They're going to be\ntalking about this for months!

label: @talk
source:
Huh..? Why, yes, this is Red's
house. I'm his mother.\p[.]\pBut why..?\pOh, what do you want to know about
him? I mean, he's a quiet boy.\pHe always was so interested in
Pokémon battle, and not much else,\lto tell you the truth[.]\pHe never had many friends at all,
except for Blue who lives next\ldoor, but[.] I don't know how good\lfriends those two really were[.]\pWait[.] Who are you to be so
curious about my son?\p[.]\pI-I don't like this very much at
all! Please leave us alone.

label: @talk2
source: I-I don't enjoy talking to you[.]\nI'd like to be left alone, please.

label: @text
source: [player] played with the NES.\p[.]\pCould it be..?\nSamus was a woman all along!

label: @notice
source: It's a posted notice[.]\pIf you really want to get annoyed,\npress the L or R Button!\pIf you really need help[.]\nGo on YouTube!

label: @TV
source: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p[.]touching!

label: @talk
source: Greetings, young one.\pI've come out here to spread the\nword about our Lord and Savior\lArceus, peace be upon him[.]\pShall I lend you my healing powers\nas I read his divine wisdom?

label: @saidYes
source: Ah!\nThe spirit of a true believer!

label: @saidNo
source: BLASPHEMY!\nETERNAL HELLFIRE AWAITS YOU!

label: @postTalk
source: "Blessed are the damaged Pokémon,\nfor they will send reckless\lTrainers to the Center of healing."

label: @lockedText
source: The door is locked.

label: @unlockedText
source: The door is open. It shows clear\nmarks of violent treatment[.]

label: @talk
source:
What in Arceus's name..?\c\h08ó
A Rocket, in our innocent lab?\pWhat--\c\h08ó no, goodness, no!\c\h08ó
Professor Oak is not in.\pAnd I doubt very much he'd want
anything to do with you if he\lwere!

label: @talk
source: Oh, my!\c\h08ó W-why, no, I'm afraid\nProfessor Oak is not here.\pH-he has pressing research matters\nto attend elsewhere in the region.\p[.]\pP-please don't hurt me!

label: @talk
source:
Now, I'll say! You've got some
nerve coming here, Rocket.\pProfessor Oak is an honest man,
and a respected academic!\pHe has no business with thugs
like you!

label: @standardText
source: It's crammed full of Pokémon\nbooks.

label: @switch
source: It's crammed full of Pokémon\nbooks.\c\h08ó.\c\h08ó.\p[.]but behind one is a secret\nswitch! Press it?

label: @yesText
source: Who wouldn't?

label: @noText
source: Not quite yet!

label: @challengeText
source: The professor told us to lock the\ndoor to keep thugs like you out!\pI don't want to fight you, but\nlike my mother used to say[.]\pAlways be safe!

label: @defeatText
source: Did you not feel anything?

label: @leaveText
source: This is outrageous..!\nWe're just[.] doing our job!

label: @talk
source:
Oh, now!
Stop right there, Rocket!\pI may be a mere research aid, but
I know better than to let you put\lyour dirty fingers on the\lProfessor's rarest Pokémon!\pGet off! Or I'll put all the aides
on you!

file: scripts/pallet town/oaks lab/oaks lab level script.rbc
label: @femAideTalk
source: It's that meddling pink-haired\nRocket again!\pWe're being robbed!

file: scripts/pallet town/oaks lab/oaks lab level script.rbc
label: @aide1Talk
source: You stay away from this lab,\nscoundrel!\pI'll say!\pAides like us can bring you down,\nno problem!\pBrace yourself!

file: scripts/pallet town/oaks lab/oaks lab level script.rbc
label: @aide1Defeat
source: Beware!\nWe'll get you one day!

file: scripts/pallet town/oaks lab/oaks lab level script.rbc
label: @aide1Talk2
source: I-I'm just an aide[.]\nI've done my part!\pProfessor Oak will not stand for\nthis, I'll have you know..!

label: @challengeText
source: I-I don't know what you could\npossibly want in this Lab, thief!\pWe're hiding nothing!\n[.]we're clean!

label: @defeatText
source: Negative!

label: @leaveText

source: Red's house

Dude[.]
Technology, man. It's[.] far out!\pDid you hear about the information
super-highway?\pPretty soon, we're gonna get to
download and play all sorts of\lgames straight from the minds of\llonely geeks, without a Game Boy!\pTalk about a new world, man!

\c\h08[Ke]\c\h18\p\c\h06ÇHaving the Boulderbadge makes

this huge world of ours.\pYou may even encounter a few bad
ones who try to steal from you!\pBut don't worry about them!
They never win in the end[.]

How could you?!\pYou people, I swear[.]\c\h08ó
You'll never win in the end!\p[.]\pBye-bye, [buffer1][.]\c\h08ó
I hardly knew you[.]\pYou were the hardest of rocks[.]

(Snivel[.])\p[.]\c\h08ó
I guess you want a TM too, huh?

label: @talk
source: I'll be damned if our nurse isn't\nthe most passive-aggressive health\lcare worker in Kanto[.]\pSometimes I prefer just to heal my\nPokémon with Potions[.]

label: @talk
source:
There aren't many serious Pokémon
Trainers here.\pThey're all like Bug Catchers,
you know, just hobbyists.\pPrime targets for your brand of
thievery, aren't they, Rocket?\pHahahaha[.]
Poor bastards.

source:
A Pokémon becomes easier to

a sure thing!\pThat's why I want to steal Pokémon
like you, Rocket!\p[.]
Don't tell grandpa!

label: @talk

source: I am also led to believe that this\norganization has perpetrated a\lnumber of lesser crimes, primarily\laround the Celadon area, but that\lthe local police force has had a\ltendency to turn a blind eye to\lthese misdemeanors.

source: I have therefore decided to\ninitiate a new program to combat\lorganized crime.\pWe will bring the Rockets to\njustice!

label: @champTalk7

label: @champTalk8

You've positively shocked me.\pBecause of our meaningful past
together, I want least of all to\lmake accusations against you,\lbut you leave me little choice.\pMy recent investigations have led

Prof. Oak

source: Blaine: Argh!\pSo you've come for me at last,\nhave you? Giovanni's pet.

label: @intro
source: Blaine: Argh!\pSo you've come for me at last,\nhave you? Giovanni's pet.

source: It was only a matter of time.\nBrace yourself, kid!\pI never wanted this mess, do you\nhear me? I regret everything!

label: @defeatText
source: Please[.]\nTry to understand..!

label: @talk2
source: Blaine: All right, all right!\nHave it your way, Rocket!\p[.]\pHe just can't seem to get it, that\nGiovanni[.]

label: @talk3
source:
I[.]\c\h08ó I believe in Team Rocket's
cause as much anyone, but[.]\pI'm a Gym Leader, and an
academic; not a petty criminal!\pWe can't all sacrifice all we
are for his pretentious ideals\lof revenge, can we?

label: @talk4
source: And now[.]\c\h08ó Oak's going to publicly\nshame me if I keep doing work for\lTeam Rocket[.]\pMeanwhile Giovanni's going to beat\nme up if I don't!\pIt's a mess!

label: @talk5
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nWell, well[.]\pI guess you've showed me that\nGiovanni for his part is serious\lin his threats[.]\p[.]

source: Look, Rocket[.]\pI'll do anything if you get your\nboss to give me a second chance.\pI--\c\h08ó I'll tell you anything you\nwant to know!

source:
Did Giovanni tell you about the
work we did in this very mansion\leleven years ago?\p[.]\c\h08ó
He did, did he?\pWell, I'll tell you something he
sure as hell didn't!

label: @talk8
source:
I happen to know that Oak lost his
faith in the Mewtwo Project long\lbefore he stood at the Plateau and\lrenounced his power.\pAlthough the project was strictly
his idea, once he saw that thing[.]\p"The Catastrophe"[.]\c\h08ó he didn't
believe a genetically engineered\lPokémon could ever win us the war.

label: @talk9
source: And do you know how I know all\nthis?\c\h08ó Because he told me!

source:
Shortly after "The Catastrophe",
Oak approached me to ask for help.\pHe told me about a brand new
scientific project that he said\lwould have the potential to[.]\p"Make the two of us far more
powerful than any Mewtwo ever\lcould[.]"

label: @talk10
source: He said he had begun work on it in\na separate secret lab of his, but\lthat he needed my assistance to\lsee it through to completion.

label: @talk11
source:
But at that point I felt things
were finally looking up with the\lMewtwo Project[.]\pI didn't want to divert my focus,
and it seemed so out of the blue[.]\lso I turned him down.\pHa!\c\h08ó Well, we both know what all my
focused effort came to in the end!

label: @talk12
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nA "secret lab"[.]\pOh, he's a shady guy, that Oak[.]\pEven disregarding his abominable\nsurrender[.]

label: @talk13
source: Listen.\pIf you can convince your boss I\nmean it, tell him I'll do whatever\lhe wants me to.\pI'll even make his precious\nPorygon again if he needs it.

label: @talk14
source:
Now, if Oak wants to rat me out,
well then[.]\pHalf this region's Leaders are in
cahoots with you guys already[.]\pI'll[.]\c\h08ó take one for the team, I
suppose.\p[.]\c\h08ó
(Sigh[.])

label: @talk15
source: I guess some extra precautions\ncouldn't hurt[.]

label: @talk16
source: Leave that Key there, if you\nwould.\pI don't want any weakling Trainers\nchallenging my Gym during times\llike these[.]

label: @talk17
source: Now leave me to it, Rocket.\c\h08ó\nYour boss gets his way today.

source: And here I always thought Rockets\nwere much too high-brow criminals\lto hang out in places like this[.]

source: You're looking for Leader Blaine,\nare you?\pChill out, Rocket[.]\nLoot some valuables with me!

source: All you organized criminals are so\nuptight. Gotta have a little fun.

source: I thought I saw that bald Gym\nLeader guy go in here earlier[.]

source: You came here on a looting raid\ntoo, didn't you, Rocket?

source: My mentor once lived here.\pNow he moved to Lavender to care\nfor orphaned Pokémon.\lTalk about a waste!

source: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!\pEither that, or jump off a bridge.\pFor thugs like you[.] I'm\nindifferent to which you choose.

source: I thought I heard an old voice\ngroaning in frustration in the\lother room!

source: Nah, it couldn't have been Gym\nLeader Blaine..?\pHe would never frequent a place\nlike this nowadays[.]

source: I think I'd almost rather see a\nghost than a thief like you!

source: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pI don't know, but remembering\nwhich way you were going before a\lwild Pokémon jumps at you helps!

source: Dude, are you, like, a Rocket?

source: Ariana: Yes, grunt?\nDo I look like Bill to you?

source: Ariana: Hope you're not all\nspineless, grunt. Haha.\pUs Rockets aren't too popular in\nLavender.

source: Ariana: It's a complete disaster[.]

source: It was eleven years ago[.]

source: Down with Lance!\pWe will not stand by and let that\nJohtoanean tyrant bring our\lglorious region to ruin!

source: My friend here is a little\nintense. I'm just in it for kicks.

source:

around Boss's office all the time.\pRumor has it she and him had a

source: Working next to Boss makes me feel\nkind of powerful.\pNot sure if anybody else can sense\nit, though[.]

label: @bosstalk1
source: Giovanni: [player], I presume?\pYeah, just come on up here by the\ndesk.

source: Giovanni: [player], I presume?\pYeah, just come on up here by the\ndesk.

label: @bosstalk2
source: Now, then.\nLet's not waste any time.

label: @bosstalk3
source: I heard from Petrel that the\nfossil excavation mission at Mt.\lMoon was wrecked by the workings\lof two little kid Trainers.

label: @bosstalk4
source: Now, between the fact that Petrel\nis the weakest of my sorry bunch\lof Rocket admins and that the\lmission team consisted of complete\land utter rookie grunts[.]

label: @bosstalk5
source: It still boggles my mind to the\ncore how in the deepest depths of\lGiratina's hell a pair of pre-teen\ltwats could beat up an entire\lsquad of full-grown men and run\laway with the spoils right in\lfront of their GOD DAMN EYES!

source: I mean, for crying out loud,\nAriana: little kids!\pHow freaking absurd is this?

source: Ariana: It's very absurd,\nGiovanni.

source: Giovanni: [.]\c\h08ó\n(Sigh[.])\c\h08ó

source:

here.\pI want you to tell me everything
you know about this kid--\pEvery little detail, every little
minutia you happened to glean from\lyour battle with him.\pI want to have this twerp
thoroughly profiled so we can see\lto it that he'll never dare mess\lwith Team Rocket again!

label: @bosstalk10
source: Let's start with the basics[.]

source: I have a bad feeling about these\ntwo--\c\h08ó this Red character\lespecially[.]\pWe'll have to keep our eyes open\nif he comes our way again, do you\lhear me?

source: (Whoever these rich kids are-- I\nswear[.])\p(They're a dangerous breed[.])

label: @bosstalk23
source: I will never deal with that filthy\ntraitor. Never! Do you hear me?

source: I want nothing to do with that\nspineless dimwit of a professor,\land you should know better than to\lsuggest it!

source:

Well, then[.]\pI suggest you talk to Bill about
it.\pHe's an unpredictable kid, but

job.

source:

of a choice.\pBill has done a couple of smaller
tech-related jobs for us in the\lpast, but he's a fickle kid, and I\ldon't like him.\pPlus, he always demands ridiculous

source:

now, Blaine-- for old time's sake.\pBut if you hinder Team Rocket's

favorable outcome.\pIs that clear?

source: I expect you to be back making\nPorygon for us again once this\lwhole Fuji business blows over.

listen carefully:\pYou're going to go to Bill's
house, just north of Cerulean.\pYou're going to offer him a job,

source:
Another squad of grunts should be
headed for Cerulean on another\lmission right about now as well.\pI suggest you rendezvous with them
in the secret Rocket base we've\lstationed just south of the city.\pThe Rocket admin there should be
able to give you a few rare items\lto tempt Bill with as well.

source: Isn't that right, Ariana?

[player].

label: @bossTalk
source: Giovanni: Ariana, it's[.]\pPositively the worst humiliation\nwe have ever been through.

source: [.]\pIf Lance and the Elite Four had\nstormed in here and busted us out,\lI would have been furious[.]\pIf some petty small-time gang\ndecided to marshall all its\lresources for a successful strike\lagainst us, I would have taken it\las a slight upon my honor[.]

source: But this, Ariana!\c\h08ó What the devil\ncould have prepared me for this?\pA child!\c\h08ó I mean[.] what in Arceus's\nname am I to make of this?!

source: The most prestigous, notorious\norganization in all of Kanto[.]\lbrought to its knees at the hands\lof some preadolescent twerp!\pI am disgusted, revulsed,\nashamed[.]\c\h08ó at our incompetence.

label: @bossTalk5
source: [.]\pI've been naive[.] underestimated\nthe kid[.] and look at him now!\pFour Badges and fully evolved\nPokémon in his arsenal[.]

source: Who knows? Before we know it he'll\nhave earned the right to challenge\lViridian Gym, and will demand that\lits Leader show up and accept his\lchallenge[.]

source: [.]\pNo, let's not get ahead of\nourselves.\pBut if it happens[.]\c\h08ó we will have\nto be ready, Ariana.

source: Which, à propos[.]\pIt would seem as if your favorite\nlittle grunt has graced us with\lhis presence.

label: @bossTalk8
source: Giovanni: [player]!\c\h08ó\nSo you've returned[.]

label: @bossTalk9
source: I'll be frank and tell you that\nFuji's antics are the least of my\lconcerns at the moment, but let's\lhear whatever you have to report\lanyway.\pQuickly, you hear?

label: @bossTalk10
source: [.]\pWhat's that?\c\h08ó\nThere's more?

label: @bossTalk11
source: [.]\pOh?\p[.]\c\h08ó\nOh!\c\h08ó Could it be..?

source: Well, fine-- you've piqued my\ninterest.\pTake it from the start, if you\nwould[.]

source: So Oak is looking for Fuji, is he?\pGod, what is he planning?!\c\h08ó\nDoes he know about us..?\pThis could be bad[.]\c\h08ó\nThis could be very bad indeed[.]

label: @bossTalk15
source: [.]\c\h08ó\n(Sigh[.])\pI think, [player][.]\pI think it's about time you\nlearned the truth.

source:
The things that happened in secret
in that final year of the war[.]\pI never thought to tell it all to
a mere grunt, but[.]\pI believe you've proven yourself
worthy of hearing it.\pAnd if you're going to work with
me to set things straight, it's\lbest you had it clean from me.

label: @bossTalk17
source: I'm going to tell you everything.

label: @talk
source: Giovanni: Come on now!\pGet on over to Bill's house north\nof Cerulean and don't come back\luntil you've made that dork take\lthe offer!

label: @talk2
source: Giovanni: Get moving, [player]!\pHead on over to Lavender Town east\nof here and teach that Mr. Fuji a\llesson!

source: Giovanni: I'm very busy right now,\n[player].\pI'd rather you didn't disturb me,\nall right?

source: Giovanni: Onwards to Pallet Town,\n[player]! No loitering about!

source: Boss is very busy right now.\pHe hasn't got time for grunts like\nyou.

source: Don't go thinking you're special\nnow just because you get missions\lfrom Boss, all right?
