source: I guess some of you Rockets turn\nout half-decent Trainers, huh?

label: @preJulienTalk
source: What are you looking at, Rocket?\pYou got what you came for, didn't\nyou? (Snigger[.])

label: @postJulienTalk
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
W-wow[.]\pI'll be damned, Rocket[.]\c\h08ó
You beat Julien?!\pThat guy's one of the scariest
fellows we deal with[.]\pHe knows folks in high places, and
always gets his way, you know.\pIf he's really gone for good now,
we owe you one, Rocket.\pTake this as a sign of respect
from us Bottoms.

label: @postGiftTalk
source: You cool, Rocket.\nUs Bottoms have got your back.

label: @noRoomTalk
source: You dummy!\nYou've no room for it!

label: @itemMsg
source: [player] received the Black Belt!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put the Black Belt in\nthe Items pocket.

label: @friendlyTalk
source:
Why[.]
I know you, bud!\pWe had ourselves a nice talk in my
joint in the Underground Path!\pYou know, I'm real glad we came to
an understanding that time!\pSo[.] what's my gig and what am I
doing hanging with these hotshot\lBottoms?\pHaha! Kanto's underworld is small,
let me tell ya. Connections!\pWell, you'd know all about it,
wouldn't you, Rocket?\p[.]\pHm?\pOh, those Tops sent you down here,
did they?\p[.]\pHahaha[.]\pYeah, I know all about the gig
these Bottoms are pulling on them.

label: @friendlyTalk2
source:
Look, I[.]\pThese Bottoms are my trusted
partners, see, and I don't like to\lbust on nobody, but[.]\pYou're my homeboy, so I'll say I
can make an exception, eh?\p[.]\pThey've got an impostor going.\pOne of the Bottoms bought a
different kind of jacket, drove\lon up to Route 16 and pretended to\lbe a rookie so he'd join the Tops!\pNow he's there in among them,
messing with their bikes and with\ltheir swagger when they're not\llooking, and those Tops are none\lthe wiser!\p[.]\pYou'll know who the poor kid is
'cause he'll be the one twitching\llike mad trying to fit in!\pYou go up to Route 16 and unmask
that little mole, and I think\lthose Tops will find their\lproblems suddenly going away[.]\pHahaha[.]
Hey, you're welcome, Rocket.

label: @postFriendlyTalk
source: Hey, you're welcome, Rocket.\pYou'll know who the impostor on\nRoute 16 is 'cause he'll be the\lone twitching like mad trying to\lfit in!

label: @angryTalk
source:
Hey[.]
I know you!\pYou're that Rocket dude who came
and made trouble up in my joint in\lthe Underground Path!\pDon't you go thinking I'd forget a
thing like that, now!\p[.]\pOh[.] hah! So that's what you're
doing here, is it?\pTrying to help these Tops up here
with some gang dispute?\l(Snigger[.])\pKid, I got enough influence in the
Kanto underworld to end a strife\llike this with the flick of my\lwrist, you know that?

label: @angryTalk2
source:
But see[.]
I don't feel like doing that.\pI got a deal going with these
Bottoms, and if they want to keep\lmessing with those Tops of yours,\lI say they're welcome to!\pMatter of fact, I think[.]
Troublemaker like you[.]\pDeserves to get taught lesson that
you ought to have learned last\ltime you meddled in my affairs!\c\h0B[Ke]À\pThis time it's all out, kid.
I'll have you in the ground!

label: @defeatText
source: Disgusting!

label: @angryTalk3
source:
Gah!
You never learn, do you..?\pI'm done with you for good now,
you got that?\p[.]\pAnd what else?
Oh, yeah[.]\pI think on my way outta here, I'll
stop by those Tops and tell 'em\lthe Bottoms member that's been\lmessing with them all this time[.]\pIs this little pink-haired Rocket
punk!\pTrusted businessman like me[.]
It's your word against mine, pal.\pHahaha[.]
See you in hell, Rocket.

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @preQuestTalk
source: Quit your glaring, Rocket!\pYou got no business with us\nBottoms, and I damn well don't\lthink you want it!\pStay out of our way!

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @guardTalk
source:
Huh? You came to mess with us
Bottoms?\p[.]
You want to see our boss?\pThat's gotta be a joke, you little
city gangster wimp!\pLook, we put some of our falcons
out on duty on Route 17.\pIf you can't even show you got the
hustle to beat them, our boss\lwon't give you the time of day!

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @guardTalk2
source:
Hmph!
You got guts, Rocket!\pYou want to talk to our boss?
Fine.\pWhen he beats you to a pulp for
wasting his time, it's on you.\p[.]\pI'm keeping my eye on you, pal!

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @talk
source:
Well, well, well!\pSo you're the nervy Rocket who's
been knocking out our falcons from\lRoute 17?\pAll right, all right, you got my
attention, kid; what do you want?\p[.]\pOh, I shoulda known.
The tops sent ya?\pThey sent you down to set things
straight, did they?\pWell, all right[.]\pThing you gotta know about the way
things work around here, mister\lhigh-brow city criminal[.]\pIs there's only one way we really
settle things for good.\p[.]\pCold, hard, muscle-fuelled battle.\c\h08ó
[.]\c\h08óPokémon Battle.

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @defeatText
source: You're quite a little rascal,\naren't you?

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @talk2
source:
[.]
Damn it all[.]\pAll right, Rocket!\pEven with a thug like you, we
never violate our code of honor.\pWe'll stay out of the Tops' turf
and keep our smack-talking to our-\lselves, ya hear?\pYou can run tell that to the Tops
leader and he'll be real happy.\p[.]\pNow, these accusations about some
sabotage or other[.]\pHahahaha[.]\pI can't say I know anything about
it, bud.\pMaybe it'll stop someday, maybe it
won't? I don't know.\pI done everything within my power
here, so don't you look at me!\p[.]\c\h08ó
Hehehehehe[.]

file: scripts/route 18 (cycling road bottom)/main bottoms guard + leader.rbc
label: @postBossTalk
source: Well, you fancy Rocket thug[.]\pMaybe you ain't all such a sissy\nafter all.

label: @postBattle
source: That doesn't mean you can have any\nof my Pokémon, you thug!

label: @postBattle
source: But I'd rather get sunburnt that\nhave my Pokémon stolen! Shoo!

label: @postBattle
source: Lia: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI shudder to think what lessons he\nwould learn from you, Rocket!

label: @postBattle
source: Luc: My sis protects me from bad\npeople like you..!

label: @postBattle
source: I'm supposed to guard these ladies\nhere from people like you, huh?\pWell, I'm not off to a very good\nstart[.]

label: @postBattle
source: For you, jail, I hope!

label: @postBattle
source: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPokémon.\pI would never steal them, as you\ndo!

label: @postBattle
source: What is this, has Team Rocket gone\naquatic?

label: @defeat
source: Oh, no, no, no!

label: @postBattle
source: Damn it, Rocket!\nI didn't mean it like that!

label: @talk
source: Run for your life!\nI have AID--\p[.]\pEr[.] I mean, I'm one of Prof.\nOak's aides, of course.

label: @talk
source:
Hey there, good fellow! Nice
weather we're having, ain't it?\pNow, I got this hunch, see[.]\pI think you came here because
you're looking for a certain HM\lthat lights up caves[.] hmm?\p[.]\pHaha! How did I know?\pWell, let's just call it a
businessman's intuition!\pAnyhow, my dear friend, I good
good news for ya!\pWhat with my ingenuity and
entrepreneurial drive, there\lain't no need for space-taking,\ldamage-less moves any longer!\pWith our very own meticulously
crafted Flashlight, you can light\leven the darkest of caves!

label: @yesOrNo
source: [.]\pFor a mere [$]1,000 it can be\nyours! What say you, dear friend?

label: @noTalk
source:
No?
Hmph! Well, have it your way.\p(These stingy Kantoneans wouldn't
know a good deal if it tapped them\lupside the head, dammit[.])\p(How's a man to make a living
around here?)

label: @notEnoughTalk
source: Eh?\pBut you haven't even got that kind\nof money, chum!\pThis is business. Commerce, man.\nThere's no free lunch, you get me?

label: @yesTalk
source: Hey!\nThat's the spirit!\pExplore those caves, my friend!\pWith the power of electricity,\ntamed at your very fingertips, to\lguide the way!

label: @itemGet
source: [player] received the Flashlight!

label: @postBuyTalk
source: Hehe[.]\pYou might wonder how I get away\nwith selling what is basically\l19th century technology at such\loutrageous prices.\pSimple-- because nobody else in\nthis wacky region are selling it!\pHaha!

label: @talk
source: Why do you think a move like Flash\nwas ever invented?\pTo waste a slot in your Pokémon's\navailable moves, probably!

label: @talk
source: I went inside Rock Tunnel, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\p[.]\pBut I don't want to learn Flash!\nIt's such a useless move[.]

label: @text
source: I've seen this little red-haired\nkid around the forest sometimes.\pHe seems sad about something or\nother.

label: @talk
source: My-my, what's this? Did the good\nTrainer change his mind? Haha!

label: @talk2
source:
Behold!
I have returned!\pLeto, aspiring master Cutter, at
your service!\pDo you wish me to Cut down all the
trees around Pewter and Viridian?

label: @yesOrNo
source: A mere [$]1000, and you will bear\nwitness to my Cutting prowess!

label: @yesTalk
source: Ah! Sir, I daresay you made an\nexcellent choice!\pNow, if you'll allow me[.]

label: @noTalk
source:
No?\c\h08ó
Why, f-fine, then.\pI can see that this region is not
yet cultured enough to appreciate\lthe fine art of a proper Cut!\pWell, should the good sir ever
change his mind, I will never be\lfar away from any of this region's\lexquisite trees, rest assured!\pHmph! Good day.

label: @notEnoughTalk
source:
What?
Insufficient funds?\pSir, my asking price is akin to
giving it away, I assure you!\pBut[.] if the uncultured folk of
Kanto find it too great an expense\lfor witnessing the finest of fine\lart, then what is a man to do?\pWell, should the good sir ever
earn the necessary means to afford\lmy services, I will never be\lfar away from any of this region's\lexquisite trees, rest assured!\pHmph! Good day.

label: @goodBye
source:
Oh, my Lord..!
What a Cut!\pIt nigh on brings a tear to my
eye, dear Trainer[.] every time!\pWell[.] should you ever need my
Cutting skills again, by this\lregion's most beautiful trees is\lwhere you'll you find me!\pUntil we meet again!

source: Ah[.]\nI can't feel my legs[.]

label: @text
source: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThis wild man who looks like a\nsailor keeps jumping out of the\lwoodworks offering to Cut them!

label: @talk
source: Marvellous, marvellous, honey!\nNow bend down just a little more[.]

label: @talk
source: Gah!\pWhy are barging into my house,\nRocket? I won't have it!\pIs this acceptable behavior where\nyou're from?!

label: @talk
source:
Just like that, Sarah!
Stick it out like a Lickitung!\p[.]
Hey, out the way, guy!\pWe're in the middle of an
important shoot here!

label: @text
source: Many Pokémon live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.\p[.]\pP-please don't steal mine, okay?

label: @challenge
source: I'm not surprised to see a thug\nlike you around these parts!\pTell me, did you come to burgle\nthe Pokémon Mansion?

label: @postBattle
source: Stay away from me, criminal!

label: @postBattle
source: Eeeek!\nCall the police!

label: @postBattle
source: Go float away somewhere else, you\nhooligan!

label: @postBattle
source: It's a good thing they keep\noutlaws like you out of here!\pYou might disturb the beautiful\nbird that lives in the cavern!

label: @challenge
source: That's a nice Pokémon you're\nriding!\pI sure hope you didn't steal it\nfrom some poor little girl!

label: @postBattle
source: Well, stolen or not[.]\nIt looks pretty darn cool.

label: @postBattle
source: Well, did you take a lot of loot\nfrom that Pokémon Mansion, Rocket?

label: @postBattle
source: I seem to only catch Magikarp!\pAnd here I thought the Rod I got\nfrom the Guru in Vermillion was\lthe very best Rod there is[.]

label: @postBattle
source: I heard the Fishing brothers\naround Kanto have some well-kept\lsecrets about how to hook fish!\pWhat I wouldn't give to figure out\nthose[.]

label: @postBattle
source: Where'd you steal those Pokémon?

label: @talk
source: Out of my way if you know what's\ngood for you!

label: @talk2
source: Lance: Giovanni?!

label: @talk3
source:
No[.]\c\h08ó You're just one of his more
well-dressed goons, aren't you?\pOff to loot some exotic Pokémon from
travelling Victory Road Trainers?\pI'll say[.]\c\h08ó that's a real menace to
safety for League challengers!

label: @talk4
source: And most decidedly[.]\c\h08ó\nNot my problem anymore!

label: @talk5
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
Well..?\pHaven't you heard, bum?\c\h08ó
Ha!\pThen I'll spare you the effort of
burgling the newsstand tomorrow!

label: @talk6
source: It's over!\c\h08ó\nI'm no longer Champion!

label: @talk7
source:
A decade of unchallenged reign[.]\c\h08ó
Gone, in an instant!\pBy some[.]\pGod, I can't even say it!\c\h08ó
What will my grandfather think..?!\pSome little kid from some middle-
of-nowhere town!

label: @talk8
source: It's[.]\c\h08ó\nPositively absurd[.]

label: @hey

all the trees around Cerulean?

[player]: I'm a member of a
criminal organization.\p[player]: But I don't steal from
little girls every chance I get!\p[player]: I wonder why I joined in

But that's my favorite hobby!

label: @talk
source: I don't know if I really trust\nyou, but our Master says it's OK!

label: @talk
source: Grr[.] If the Elite Four found out\nwe let a Rocket in here[.]

label: @talk
source: Psychic and Flying-type Pokémon\nare the bane of my existence!\pThank you for taking out that\lannoying Mr. Psychic.

label: @talk
source: You must be strong, Rocket!\pYou have earned the tiniest grain\nof my respect.

label: @talk
source:
Hooh-ha!
What's this?\pA criminal has entered our dojo!
They warned us about you! Hwah!\pYou! Rocket!
Are not welcome here!\pBe gone! Leave us!
Don't come back! Ha-yah!

label: @talk2
source:
You!
Hooh-ha!\pDouble-crosser!
Evil Rocket! Haaah!\pYou cannot enter! My Dojo!
Be gone! Chaaa-yah!

label: @text
source: Better not get greedy[.]\nHonor among thieves and all that[.]

label: @talk
source: As your reward! Hoo-hah!\pTake one of our prized Fighting\nPokémon behind me! Haaah!

label: @takenTalk
source: Rocket! I am in your debt!\nHee-haah!\pStay, if you would!\nAnd train karate with us! Hoo-yah!

label: @talk
source:
Hooah!
Rocket! Talk to me!\p[.]\pSorry about kicking you out
earlier! Very sorry!\pIt's Pokémon League policy!\pThey would not let us keep our
Dojo if we didn't comply! Hyaah!\pBut! Perhaps we could make an
exception! Perhaps! Maybe! Hah!\pListen up!

label: @talk2
source:
In a house in this city! Hoo-ah!
Down south! By the Pokémon Center!\pThere lives an old bald man!\pCalls himself Mr. Psychic!
Hoo-yah! Stupid name! Yes!\pThis man! He is very bad for our
Dojo! Yes-yes! Very bad!\pHe sits in his house! Gives out
the TM for Psychic!\pTo all and every passerby
Trainers! Argh!\pWith this move! Grrr!\pThey knock out all our Fighting-
type Pokémon! In one hit! Hah!

label: @talk3
source:
You! Rocket!
Go beat up Mr. Psychic! Ha-yah!\pTell him, Rocket! No more TM
Psychic for Trainers! Mmmmmyah!\pIf you do this! Chaaaah!\pI will give to you! A special
reward! And[.] my respect! Ho!

label: @talk4
source: Ah! Rocket! Hooohah!\nHow is it going?\pDid you teach Mr. Psychic a\nlesson? Heeyah!

label: @postBeatUpTalk
source: Huzzah!\nYou did? Ha-ha! Yes!\pMany thanks, Rocket!\pCome inside! Inside my Dojo!\nAnd you will have your reward! Ha!

label: @abortionTalk
source:
Hooo[.] huuh..?
You refused? To beat him up?\pHe gave you? A TM?
You let him? Let him go?\pArgh! Haaaah!
You double-crossing fiend!\pYou will not be allowed!
To enter my Dojo! Ever!\pGood-bye! Hooo-yaah!

label: @talk
source: When I grow up, I'm gonna work at\nSilph!\pEverybody here knows that's the\nway to get super rich!

label: @talk2
source: Ha-ha, Rocket!\pI knew you bad guys would be no\nmatch for Silph!

label: @talk
source:
Ugh[.] You came from Celadon,
didn't you, Rocket?\pThat crime-infested gambling-
fueled hole[.]\pSaffron is clean and straight!
We'll never accept your kind here.

label: @talk2
source: I hope you Rockets have learned\nyour lesson now!\pThere's no place for you in Saffron!\nGo back to where you came from!

label: @talk
source:
D-don't call her that!
That's a made-up fantasy name!\pYour friend has been acting
strange lately.\pI think she's not feeling well
right now. She needs to stay home.

label: @talk
source:
Ah[.] Welcome back, Mr.--
[.]\pWhy, you're not employed by Silph,
are you?\pThen I'm afraid I can't let you
through. Good day.

label: @talk
source: Only authorized personel through\nhere, I'm afraid.

of Pokémon Trainers.\pThe way they look in battle[.]
They are the picture of coolness.\pHah! But we'll never talk about
petty Rockets like you.

label: @talk

Sabrina when I came here.\pBut that promoter at the door
still won't let me in!\pThere's got to be some shady guy
who can make me a fake Trainer\lCard somewhere[.]

label: @talk

label: @talk

Kanto family business, now has a\lnear nationwide monopoly on the\lproduction of Poké Balls!\pFuschia's Safari Zone is also
attracting an ever-increasing mass\lof tourists.\pAnd that isn't even to mention
what the region's brightest\lentrepeneurs have in store for\lSaffron and Lavender in the coming\lyears!\pYes, Kanto has turned out quite
the prosperous region, rest\lassured.

altogether and resigned himself\lcompletely to his Pokémon\lresearch?\pI understand his Pokédex system
has become quite renowned in\lacademic circles-- even in Hoenn.\pIt's quite impressive.

political history intrigues me,\lLance.\pIf you don't mind my asking[.]\pWhy in the world do you think such

Champion, wouldn't you say?

old man got scared for his life,\lsimple as that.\pSome high-level Kanto scientists

under our control, victory was more\lor less guaranteed either way.

label: @adminTalk8

label: @stoneTalk6
source: Steven: Hm[.]\pWell, it was an interesting turn\nof events in any case, I have to\lsay.

label: @talk1
source: Ah[.] Nothing like a full pipe of\nsailor's baccy after a meal[.]\pMy, if only all my afternoons were\nthis peaceful[.]

label: @talk2
source:
Blargh[.]\pAw[.]
(Cough), (splat)\pI can't command the ship
in this condition!\pMy, what I wouldn't give for a
good back massage right about now!

label: @sign1
source: It's empty[.]

label: @sign2
source: Chunks of sauteed Magikarp lie\nfloating in a pile of vomit[.]\pThe sight would surely make a\nyounger person squirm in disgust!

label: @talk
source: [.]\n!!!\pOh, never mind me, I'm just a\lregular old man going about my\lregular old man business! Haha!

label: @talk
source: Proton: There you are.\nWell, we better get searching!\lThose Pokémon crates have got to\lbe somewhere or other[.]

label: @talk1
source: Oh, hello there!\pIt is my hobby to stare at\nTrainers from all around the world\lwhile they sleep!\pWill you humor me by having a\nrest?

label: @talk2
source: What, creepy?\pI assure you, home in Unova,\nstaring at people resting is a\lnational passtime.\pYou Kanto people are just way too\nstuck-up.

label: @talk3
source: Hmm[.] that was quite a delight.\pYour sleeping rhythms are pretty\nfrenetic.\pDo you have a bad conscience?

label: @talk
source: Ah, welcome aboard! That is quite\nthe[.] original party attire.

label: @talk
source: Did you hear about the famous man\nfrom Hoenn who's aboard with us?\pA handsome lad, but so picky with\nhis palate!

label: @after
source: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen I can learn to be bad like\nyou when I grow up!\pDon't tell mom!

label: @after
source: Party?\pYeah, I'm as disappointed as you,\nman. Where are all the hot chicks?

label: @talk
source: Dragon Pokémon are evil and\ndemonic.\pThe way that Lance openly flaunts\nthem[.] I do not approve of this\lregion's blasphemic culture.

label: @talk
source:
I admire the Captain's
resillience.\pWhile the passengers are out
battling each other and gloating\lover celebrities[.]\pHe sits in his cabin, smoking his
pipe and honing his masterful\lCutting skills.

label: @talk
source: They say that in all his decades\nof commanding ships, the Captain\lhas never been seasick.\pOh! A resolute soul as well as\nartistic ability! He is the man!

label: @talk
source:
All the people here are obsessing
over the political guests[.]\pWe admire the Captain so much
more.\pThe way he Cuts[.] It is a master-
ful work of art, it really is.

label: @challenge
source: My dad had me doll up for the\nparty just in case Lance came by.

label: @defeat
source: But I'm so pretty!

label: @after
source: Isn't that how Lorelei got into\nthe Elite Four[.] by being pretty?

label: @talk
source: Oh, oh, oh!\pI want to see Lance so bad, but my\ndad won't let me[.]

label: @talk
source: They say this ship's Captain is a\nlegendary Cut master!\pHe has inspired admirers for his\nCutting skills around the world.

label: @talk
source: I hear there's a lot of commotion\ngoing on by the balcony upstairs.\pI can't be bothered to check it.\nI'm too old for this stuff.

label: @truck
source: It's an old, worn-down truck.

label: @liftTruckText
source: With the power of Strength[.]\c\h08ó\n[player] managed to lift the truck\lvery slightly[.]

label: @nothing
source: [.]\c\h08ó\nThere was nothing underneath.

label: @pkmnText
source: There was a Pokémon hiding\nunderneath!

label: @fledText
source: Mew flew away into the distance[.]

label: @adminTalk
source: Proton: Well, that's the last one.\pI'll have the Pokémon moved to the\nappropriate location on my own.\pFor now I'm just happy to be off\nthis ship-- pretentious parties\land "people of influence" make me\lalmost as sick as the swaying of\lthe waves.

label: @adminTalk2
source: Speaking of meaningless things[.]\c\h08ó\nHave a look at that.

label: @adminTalk3
source: Whose bright idea was it to put\nsome great big truck out on this\ltiny island out in the ocean?\p[.]\pWell, I suppose it makes for a\ngreat place to hide something in\lplain sight that's out of people's\lreach.\pGo figure.

label: @adminTalk4
source:
Proton: Well, what are you
standing around for, grunt?\pMission's over.
Nothing more to see here.\pI figure Boss will have some other
mission for you by now, starboy.\pHead back to HQ in Celadon.
I'm off.

label: @talk
source: What do you think you're doing,\npunk? Out of my face!

label: @talk
source:
Oh, I'm so happy to finally be
here with you, Julien!\pI couldn't stand waiting any
longer[.]\pI came as soon as I could, you
know. Like we promised[.]

label: @talk2
source:
Huh, what?
You came to save me?\pNo, no!
You don't understand.\pJulien saved me. He's going to get
me out of this lifestyle, see?\pIt'll be just me and him together.
He's got it all planned out[.]

label: @talk3
source: I don't know what made you come\nhere, but I don't need saving[.]\pI-I'm fine, see..?

label: @talk
source: Yeah, whatever, hon.\pYou be good and I'll take care of\nyou real nice.

label: @talk2
source:
What do you want, pal?
You know the drill.\pAny of these ladies cause you any
trouble, come talk to me.\pThis one here's occupied for the
time being, 'kay?

label: @talk3
source:
[.]\pPersistent, ain't ya?\c\h08ó
[.]\pOh, the old bald man sent you, did
he?\pLook, man.\pDon't try to get involved with
stuff that you got nothing with.\pLady came here of her own free
will, 'kay?\pI'm helping her put her life
back together-- is that what the\lold guy's planning on doing, huh?

label: @talk4
source: [.]\nTell you what.\pI'll give you [$]5,000 straight\nright now and we'll leave this all\lbehind us, 'kay?

label: @yesOrNo
source: It'll be like nothing ever\nhappened.

label: @yesTalk
source:
There you go.
No trouble at all.\pI'm glad we could see eye to eye,
buddy.\pYou're cool. Keep it classy, man.
Be seeing you around.

label: @noTalk
source: No?\pWell, you sure like to get real\nloyal real fast, don't you?\pLook, I didn't want no trouble,\nbut you're really asking for it,\lyou know!

label: @noTalk2
source: You got no business coming here,\nand now you made me mad!\pI won't have it!

label: @defeat
source: You meddling idiot!

label: @afterTalk
source:
Grr[.]\pWhat the hell do you think you're
doing, pal?\pYou think any good's gonna come of
this, huh?\pThis isn't the last you've heard
from me, punk! You remember that!\pAnd when I see you again, you bet
your ass I won't be taking it easy\lon you!

label: @ladyTalk
source:
Oh no..!
How could he leave me like this?\pI thought he was going to[.]\c\h08ó
Oh, who am I fooling?\p[.]\pWell, what do I do now?
I can't make it on my own!\pI-- I'll just have to go back to
the old guy.\pThat's what he wanted, right?
Least he paid me okay[.]

label: @ladyTalk2
source:
[.]\pI know this is stupid, but[.]\pC-can you help me somehow, Rocket?
I got nobody, and[.] I-I can't get\la job anywhere[.]\p[.]
Please. Anything at all.\pCome see me in the other
Underground Path if you find\lsomething for me, okay?

label: @postBribeTalk
source: Hey there, buddy. We're doing just\nfine here. You enjoying yourself?

label: @talk
source: Got a light, handsome?

label: @talk
source: I'm good, you know.

label: @talk
source: You doing all right there, mister?\n(Giggle)

label: @talk
source: Oh, no need to make no trouble\nabout it. Just chill.

label: @talk
source: This Underground Path[.] I never\nnoticed it as a child, but[.]\pIt has got to be the shadiest\nplace in this whole region[.]

label: @talk
source: I got no reason to come here if\nthat one from Hoenn's not around.\pWhat happened, man?

label: @talk2
source: What do you want with me, stupid?

label: @talk
source: Hey, where's the Hoenn doll, eh?\nI'm not paying if she's gone!

label: @talk2
source: Eh?

label: @talk
source: Hi, Rocket.\nI-I'm fine, I think.\pDid you find something for me to\ndo?

label: @talk2
source: [.]\pNo?\nOh, okay. Well, whatever[.]

label: @jobTalk
source:
[.]\pWhat, really?\pI can come be a Pokémon Center
nurse in[.]\c\h08ó Pewter City?\pGosh, that's so far away, but[.]\c\h08ó
I'd like that very much!\p[.]\pIn fact, Rocket[.]
I got no reason to wait.\pI'll leave for Pewter right away!

label: @tylerTalk
source: Hang on, you two!

label: @tylerTalk2
source:
What are you trying to meddle
with, Rocket?\pAnd here I thought you were some-
one I could count on!\pI think Miss Hoenn's quite happy
just where she is, thanks!\pShe's not going anywhere!\pYou want to challenge my judge-
ment, pal? Well, come at me!

label: @defeatText
source: All is lost!

label: @tylerTalk3
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
So that's it, huh?\p[.]\c\h08ó
You're gonna take her away[.]\pWell[.]\c\h08ó I guess[.]\c\h08ó she was gonna get
old someday anyway[.]\p(Sigh[.])\c\h08ó
Business is business.

label: @jobTalk2
source: Y-you can't tell me what to do\nanymore, old man!\pI'm off to Pewter City!

label: @talk
source: She's so exotic, so different from\nthe others. Where'd she go?\pThis is wasting my time.

label: @talk2
source: What do you want?

label: @talk
source:
Hey-hey! Take it easy, folks.
We all know miss Hoenn's popular\laround here.\pAh[.] see, but fame is a burden,
you know what I'm saying?\pShe's just off on vacation for a
little bit, is all.\pShe'll be back in no time at all,
gentlemen. You hear?

label: @talk2
source: Hey, you. You're not a Rocket, are\nyou? Listen for a sec.\pHelp me out with something, okay?\nI'll make it worth your while.

label: @yesTalk
source:
The best girl I got, man.
She ran off without a word.\pLured away by the this young
hotshot nobody who runs the joint\lin the other Underground Path over\lon Route 5.\pThat rookie don't know nothing
about the game except charming\laway older folks' profit-makers!\pIt ain't right, man!\pGet over there and get her back
for me, would ya?\pAnd give that wannabe-kid a good
round for me too if you can!

label: @noTalk
source: Fine. Whatever, buddy.\nDo as you please.

label: @midTalk
source: Well, how's it going?\nFound miss Hoenn for me yet?

label: @postBribeTalk
source:
Wait, what?!
You let the kid go with it?\pArgh!
Why did I ever trust you?\pDamn it all! Do you know what
you've done, Rocket?\pI can't keep this place going
without her[.]

label: @rewardTalk
source: Ah, there you are, Rocket!\pThanks for teaching the riffraff a\nlesson, and for returning me to\lprofitability!\pI am a man of my word, you know.\nTake this for a job well done.

label: @amuletGet
source: [player] received the Amulet Coin!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put the Amulet Coin in the\nItems pocket.

label: @noRoomTalk
source: Oh, you haven't got room for it?\nMake some!

label: @postRewardTalk
source: You're cool, Rocket.\pIf you ever need anything from me,\nman[.] don't hesitate to ask.

label: @postRunawayTalk
source: [.]\pYou know[.] maybe I'm just gettin'\ntoo old for the game.\pI ain't as cold[.] as unattached as\nI once was anymore.\pWell, what can you do?

label: @talk
source: I'm bored, you know.\nWant to talk to me?

label: @talk
source: Lost your way, sweetie?

label: @talk
source: How's your night going? It could\nalways be better, you know.

label: @talk2
source: The ship set sail, I'm afraid.\pTrust me, there's nothing at all\nto see out on the harbor now.\pYou'll bore yourself to death back\nthere!

label: @talk
source:
Hello there!
I'm the Fishing Guru!\p[.]\pOh[.] you're one of those Rockets
from the TV, aren't you?\pHmm[.]\pLook, I can't have you seen out in
public using my Rod! But[.]\pIf you'll do me a favor[.] Just
between me and you, of course[.]\pI might get you some special
treats I fished up for you[.]\pWhat do you say?

label: @superRodStolenTalk
source:
Well, well, well!
My Rocket Spy!\pDid you manage to get ahold of
some of my brothers' secrets?\p[.]\pOh me, oh my!
Tell me more!\p[.]\pGosh, why did I never think of
that..?\p[.]\pMuahahahahah[.]\pNow I know nobody can challenge my
status as the Fishing Guru!\pThanks to you, bud, I can stay on
top of my fishing game yet!

label: @oneStolenTalk
source:
Well, well, well!
My Rocket Spy!\pDid you manage to get ahold of
some of my brothers' secrets?\p[.]\pOh me, oh my!
Tell me more!\p[.]\pWait[.]\c\h08ó what?!\pYou refuse to tell me about my
younger brother's secret?!\p[.]\pYou're some weird-ass double-
crosser, aren't you?\pHow hard is it to stay consistent?

label: @superRodSparedTalk
source:
Well, well, well!
My Rocket spy!\pDid you manage to get ahold of
some of my brothers' secrets?\p[.]\pWhat?!\c\h08ó
You won't tell me?\p[.]\c\h08ó
Not one of them..?!\pDarn you, little petty criminal!\pWhat did my brothers tempt you
with, eh?\pA free copy of their own superior
rods, I'll bet..!\p(Sob[.])\c\h08ó
(Snivel[.])\p[.]\pI-I'm the original Fishing Guru,
you know[.]

label: @goodRodStolenTalk
source:
Well, well, well!
My Rocket Spy!\pDid you manage to get ahold of
some of my brothers' secrets?\p[.]\pOh me, oh my!
Tell me more!\p[.]\pGosh, why did I never think of
that..?\p[.]\pHurry now to my other brother on
Route 12!\pIf you can get me his secret as
well, you will have your reward!

label: @goodRodSparedTalk
source:
Well, well, well!
My Rocket spy!\pDid you manage to get ahold of
some of my brothers' secrets?\p[.]\pWhat?!
You won't tell me?\pWhat in tarnation are you talking
about?\pHmph!\pWell, you had better get me the
secret of my brother on Route 12's\lRod, you hear me?

label: @giveRewardTalk
source: Accept my gift for a job well\ndone, Rocket.\pI fished it up from deep down\nway back before my brothers\lentered this business, I tell ya!

label: @giveRewardSmallTalk
source:
Well[.]
Hahahaha[.]\pI can't help but reward you for
showing me my other brother's\lsecret, can I?\pIt will be plenty to make sure my
Rod reclaims its place at the top\lof the market!\pTake this, ya weirdo!

label: @itemMsg
source: [player] obtained the Blue Flute!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put the Blue Flute in\nthe Items pocket.

label: @itemMsg2
source: [player] obtained the\nMystic Water!

label: @putAway2
source: [player] put the Mystic Water\nin the Items pocket.

label: @noRoomTalk
source: You have no room, Rocket!\nMake some!

label: @happyTalk
source: Huh, what were you expecting?\p[.]\pA ROD?!\nHahahahaha[.]\pWhy, you've already got Surf, what\nthe hell do you need a Rod for?

label: @sadTalk
source: (Sob[.])\c\h08ó\n(Snivel[.])\p[.]\pI-I'm the original Fishing Guru,\nyou know[.]

label: @noTalk
source: Suit yourself, bro.\nI don't need your help!

label: @yesTalk
source:
Very good. Now listen.\pI've got these two brothers. One
in Fuschia and one on Route 12.\pI am the Fishing Guru, see?!\pThose twats don't have half the
experience in the fishing game as\lI do!\pAnd yet, what do I see in the
ponds and lakes around Kanto?\pYoung, attractive Trainers fishing
about with my brothers' Rods!\pI can't believe it!
Why?!\pAre they somehow better than mine?
How could that possibly be?\pI want you to go spy on them for
me, Rocket! Do you understand?\pI want you to get to the bottom
about what's so special about\lthose Rods and report it to me!\pPry them from their dead hands if
you have to!\pGo do this, and I promise
I'll reward you handsomely.

label: @talk2
source: [.]\pOf course, you musn't tell anyone\nthat I said "pry it from their\ldead hands if you have to" about\lmy brothers.\pI have a family-friendly\nreputation to maintain, you see.

label: @talk
source: Hmm?\nYes, I'm one of Prof. Oak's aides.\p[.]\pWha-- no, no!\nThat's "aides". A-I-D-E-S, see.

label: @talk
source: Hey, you got stuff to do, don't\nyou Rocket?\pHahah!\pOr did you want to hear about the\ntime electric Pokémon saved me\lfrom those Johto bastards during\lthe war?

label: @talk2
source:
Hey! You got ahold of those
crates, then?\pAnd battled it out with the
Captain, too, did you?\pWell, it's just like I always used
to say!\pAin't nothing like a battle to
round off a good day's smuggling!\pBwahaha!

label: @talk3
source:
Fwahahaha!
So you returned, Rocket?\pHey[.] What's that you got there?
A[.] Trainer Card?\pWell, I'll be! How much did you
pay to get that forged, eh? Haha!\pSo did you come here to challenge
me to a Gym battle?

label: @noTalk
source: Oh, the Rocket is scared of the\ngreat big lieutenant!\pHahahaha! Well, I sure would be\nif I were you!\pNo shame in it, brother!

label: @stolenTalk
source:
What in tarnation?!\c\h08ó
You stealing my Pokémon?!\p[.]\c\h08ó
Well, I'll be!\pAin't no one ever done that to me
since the war!\pYou're one feisty brute if I ever
saw one!\pWell, take this too, Rocket.
You've earned my respect.

label: @talk
source:
I'm putting up a building on this
plot of land. I own it all.\pAnd yet the Elite Four still
demand that I pay property tax!\pThose darn looters[.]
Ah[.] what's the use?\pWho is John Galt?

label: @talk
source:
Yo!
Rocket!\pLook, as far as I'm concerned,
I've never seen you enter this\lGym, all right?\pAll I know is that Surge gives me
my paycheck at the end of every\lmonth, and I don't question\lnothing else.

label: @talk
source:
I chair the Pokémon Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
Pokémon!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
Pokémon! I surely am!\p[.]Hmm?
What's that "R" stand for?\pHahaha!
I bet it's "Rapidash", isn't it?\pAh[.] you have good taste.

label: @talk
source:
Did you see the S.S. Anne moored
in the harbor?\pI tried to join the party, but the
doorman said I looked like a\lgambling drunk!\pCan you believe it?
Little old me?

label: @talk
source: I keep telling the lieutenant that\nthis Gym puzzle is the most absurd\lskill-devoid contraption ever\linvented.\pHe just scoffs and calls me a\nlightweight.

label: @talk
source: Did you know that Lt. Surge was in\nthe WAR?\p[.]\pYeah, you do?\pMaybe that's because it's all he\never talks about..?

label: @talk
source: You know, Surge had numerous kills\nduring his time in the army, but\lwhat fascinates me most[.]\pIs that he managed to pilot a\nplane when he's seven feet tall.

label: @sign1
source: Vermilion Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Lt. Surge\pWinning Trainers:\n

label: @sign2
source: Vermilion Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Lt. Surge\pWinning Trainers:\nBlue

label: @sign3
source: Vermilion Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Lt. Surge\pWinning Trainers:\nBlue, Red

label: @sign4
source: Vermilion Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Lt. Surge\pWinning Trainers:\nBlue, Red, Mohammed Smith

label: @sign
source:
Dear Pippi,
I hope to see you soon.\pI swear I've never been to the
Underground Path.\pThat was just a lie Susie said
because she's jealous.\pBest wishes,
John

label: @talk
source: They say prominent politicians\nwill be attending the party on the\lS.S. Anne.\pBut I couldn't afford a ticket,\nand I'm not good-looking enough to\lget in without one[.]

label: @talk
source: Pokémon delivery has to be the\nmost inefficient means of commun-\lication ever, don't you think?\pI think my brother has just been\nreading too many fantasy novels.

label: @talk
source:
Well, have it your way, Rocket!\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric Pokémon
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!\c\h0B[Ke]À

label: @talk2
source: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, Rocket!\pFine, then, take the Thunderbadge!

label: @talk3
source: Well, what can I say, Rocket?\nYou done shocked me!

label: @talk4
source: The Thunderbadge cranks up your\nPokémon's Speed!\pYou're special, Rocket!\nTake this!

label: @talk5
source: Yo, bud, make room in your Bag!

label: @youngTalk
source: Oh, Lt. Surge, you're so strong!\nWe don't stand a chance against\lyou!

label: @bugTalk
source: Yeah! You're wicked powerful!\pOh, please, Surge, can't you\ntell us how you and your Pokémon\lgot so strong?\pWe want to be like you too!

label: @gymTalk
source:
Lt. Surge: Hahaha!
Well, I'll tell ya, kids!\pExercise your body by pushing
yourself a little harder every\lday!\pMake sure you and your Pokémon
both are taking your vitamins and\lgetting a good night's sleep every\lnight!\pAnd remember: It's real important
that you always eat your meats and\lyour veggies!\pHahaha! That's the way to do it,
kids! Good luck!

label: @youngTalk2
source: Did you hear that?\nWe can be strong like Surge!\pCome on, let's go work out!

label: @bugTalk2
source: Yeah!\nMan, I can't wait!\pI think I have some vitamins at\nhome-- we can go take them right\laway!

label: @gymTalk2
source:
Lt. Surge: Well, if it isn't my
favorite little Rocket man!\pHow are ya?\pNot scared lifeless from ol'
Lance's paranoid new crime-\lfighting measures, I hope? Haha!\pAnyway, I take it you brought
the regular goodies..?

label: @adminTalk
source: Proton: Yes. As a matter of fact,\nthis grunt here has brought a\lparticularly strong yield straight\lfrom our top chemists.\pIt's as promised, Surge.

label: @gymTalk3
source: Lt. Surge: Well, I'll be!\nYou guys are really something!\pLet's have it then, little buddy.

label: @steroidDelivery
source: [player] delivered the Steroids to\nLt. Surge.

label: @adminTalk2
source: Proton: Now, Surge-- the Pokémon,\nif you'd be so kind.

label: @gymTalk4
source:
Lt. Surge: Oh yeah, that's right!
The Johto beasts, right?\pYeah, I had my guys stack them in
crates and hide them somewhere\laboard the ship.\pDon't worry one bit about getting
yourselves aboard!\pThe doormen all happen to be my
folks too-- they'll let you in as\llong as I drop them a word.\pSound all right?

label: @adminTalk3
source: Proton: [.]\c\h08ó\pSo you're telling me the crates\nare all still aboard the ship?\pYou couldn't have done us the\ncourtesy of carrying them on land?

label: @gymTalk5
source: Lt. Surge: Now, Proton, easy!\pDo you know how heavy those darn\nthings are?\pIf I was to go carry those all by\nmyself, my whole back would snap\lin half, I tell ya!

label: @gymTalk6
source:
Anyway, don't you get all worked
up just yet-- you gotta look at\lthings from the bright side!\pI don't know if you heard, but
they're throwing this exclusive\lparty right on board tonight!\pRumor has it some powerful
political figures might even be\lattending, so if you're lucky you\lcould end up in some quite\lexciting company, how's that?

label: @adminTalk4
source: Proton: Yes, going out to party\nwith government officials is\ljust what we Rockets should be\ldoing right now, isn't it?

label: @adminTalk5
source:
[.]
\c\h08ó(Sigh)\pWell, I don't suppose we've got
much choice.\pLet's get going, grunt.\pNo use sitting around being
bummed out about it.

source: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.

label: @1stTalk
source:
Well, well, well!\pIf it isn't one of you Rockets
I've heard so much about!\pI am a special officer, sent by
Lance to bring you to justice!\p[.]\pWha--\c\h08ó [.]no, I won't be arresting
you; those aren't my orders.\pI am here to "facilitate your
rehabilitation"!\pI have a set of 30 freshly pressed
Ultra Balls right here, that can\lbecome yours if you keep your\lcriminal record clean long enough!

label: @1stTalk2
source:
Now, then[.]
What's your name, scoundrel?\p[.]\c\h08ó
[player]?\pWell, let me check my registry
here for a second[.]

label: @preItemTalk
source:
My, my, what have we here?
A Rocket bandit in the flesh!\pI'm to give you these 30 Ultra
Balls if you keep your record\lclean for long enough, so keep it\lcool!\p[player], is it?\c\h08ó
Well, let me see here[.]

label: @postItemTalk
source: My, my, what have we here?\nA Rocket bandit in the flesh!\p[player], is it?\c\h08ó\nWell, let me see here[.]

label: @vBadTalk
source:
My goodness!\c\h08ó Y-you're one of the
most infamous criminals in Kanto!\pThe price on your head is a
whooping [$][buffer1],000!\pGrr[.] what could you possibly want
with me, you filthy outlaw?!\pIt will take a lot more than a
couple of Pokémon trades to atone\lfor your sins, I'll tell you!

label: @vBadText
source: [blue_fr][.]well?

label: @pBadTalk
source:
Oh, my!
You're quite the villain!\pThe bounty on your head stands at
[$][buffer1],000!\pThat's nothing to joke about, son.\pUnless you plan to spend the rest
of your days in jail, I suggest\lyou change your ways soon, before\lit's all too late!

label: @pBadText
source: [blue_fr]How can I help you t[blue_fr]urn things\n[blue_fr]around?

label: @mBadTalk
source:
Hm[.] Well, I've seen worse in my
days, but you're on a dangerous\lpath, Rocket!\pThe bounty on your head stands at
[$][buffer1],000.\pCome back into the light while you
still can!

label: @mBadText
source: [blue_fr]What can I help you [blue_fr]with?

label: @nBadTalk
source:
Well, you're not so bad, are you?\pThe bounty on your head is a mere
[$][buffer1],000.\pOh, a few slip-ups here and there
happen to the best of us, right?\pI'm glad you came to me to set
things straight again[.]\c\h08ó right?

label: @nBadText
source: [blue_fr]What can I do for yo[blue_fr]u, son?

label: @iTalk
source: Oh, wow! What's this? There's no\nbounty on your head at all!\pThat's what I like to see.\pThe moral road is a narrow one,\nbut you walk it all the same!

label: @itemTalk
source: I like you, son.\pHere is a token of appreciation\nfrom the government for embracing\lyour new life as a law-abiding\lcitizen!

label: @notYetItem
source: Keep up this behavior, and these\nBalls will be yours before long.

label: @noRoomTalk
source: Why, but you've no space left for\nthem, do you? Make some room!

label: @itemMsg
source: [player] received 30 Ultra Balls\nfrom the policeman!

label: @putAway
source: [player] put the Ultra Balls in the\nPoké Balls pocket.

label: @itemAlreadyGot
source: Go seek out the officers in the\nother cities, son.\pIf you keep up your good behavior,\nthey'll reward you as I have!

label: @1pokeMsg
source: But[.] surely you can't turn in\nyour only Pokémon?\pThat would cause all sorts of\nweird question marks and humbug.\pI'm not having it!

label: @handInTalk
source: Fair enough!\pYou hand in one of your stolen\nPokémon to me, and we agree to\llower the bounty on your head in\lproportion to the Pokémon's level.

label: @handInTalk1.5
source: The bounty on you is [$][buffer1],000.\nWhich Pokémon will you hand in?

label: @handInTalk2
source: Fine. I'll lower your bounty by\n[$][buffer1],000 for this [buffer2].

label: @pkmnDeleted
source: [player] turned [buffer2] in to the\npoliceman.

label: @postDeletion
source:
You made the right choice, Rocket.
Congratulations.\pYour bounty has now been lowered
to [$][buffer1],000.\pKeep it up and you'll be a free
man in no time at all!

label: @noMoreBounty
source:
Well, I'll be!
You did the right thing, Rocket.\pYour bounty has now been
completely wiped.\pIt touches me to see that I could
help you become a free man again!

label: @bribeTalk
source:
What's that?\c\h08ó
My god! The idea!\pI am unwavering in my adherence to
my moral principles, I assure you!\p[.]\c\h08ó
(Shh[.] not so loud, now.)

label: @howMuch
source: (How much are we talking?)\n(The bounty is [blue_fr]at [$][buffer1],000[blue_fr].)

label: @noMoneyTalk
source: Gah!\p(Come back when you actually have\nthe money, and we'll talk!)

label: @postBribeTalk
source:
Mmmm!\pWell, in times like these[.]
what can you do..?\p(Your bounty has been lowered to
[$][buffer1],000, all right?)\p(But remember, son-- I sure as
heck didn't do it!)

label: @postBribeTalk2
source:
Mmmm!\pWell, in times like these[.]
what can you do..?\p(The bounty on your head has now
been completely wiped.)\p(But I know nothing about it,
you hear me?)

label: @goodBye
source: No? Well, have it your way.\nGood day, Rocket.

label: @missingnoTalk
source:
What in Arceus's name is that
Pokémon..?!\pI don't know where you got that
from, but I'll want nothing to do\lwith it!\pHand in a normal Pokémon, won't
you?!

label: @talk1
source: You're not getting through there\njust like that, you know.

label: @talk2
source: Proton: A lonely grunt walking\naround Vermilion by himself?\pI take it you're the one they sent\nto help me with the smuggling\ldeal.

label: @talk3
source: Well?\nDid you bring the goods?\pFine, move over.

label: @talk4
source: Proton: [.]\pWhat a meaningless thing\nto plant a tree right in front of\lthe entrance to a Gym.

label: @talk5
source: Well?\nYou coming?

label: @talk1
source: Welcome to the S.S. Anne!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?

label: @stopTalk
source: [player] doesn't have the needed\nS.S. Ticket.

label: @stopTalk2
source: Sorry!\nYou need a ticket to get aboard.

label: @letThrough
source: Oh? You're with the lieutenant?\nI see.\pWell, step right on through, sir.\nThe party has already begun.

label: @pre
source: Wow[.]\nYou Kantoneans dress real fancy!

label: @after
source: Hey[.] I guess some of you are a\nbit scary here too[.]

label: @pre
source: I came in here just to train.\pIt's great, 'cause none of the\nriffraff can get through the\lgates!

label: @after
source: I guess I spoke too soon[.]

label: @pre
source: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nElite Four?

label: @post
source: You got me!

label: @after
source: Some kid with a red hat came\nthrough earlier.\pHe was something[.] We don't have\nkids like that where I'm from.

label: @pre
source: I've trained all my life for this!\nI'll get to see Bruno's up close!

label: @after
source: Victory Road is no place to be a\nsore loser.

label: @pre
source: I came all this way to look at the\npretty Kanto bird. It's majestic!

label: @after
source: Shame about that policeman.\nYou're so uptight in this region.

label: @after
source: And criminals live to find\nstronger victims, is that it?!

label: @after
source: You've taught me that my boyfriend\nis a wuss who needs to train\lharder!

label: @pre
source: I heard rumors about a criminal\nintruder.

label: @post
source: I'm sure it's just talk..!

label: @after
source: Keep your hands to yourself,\nmister!

label: @after
source: B-but[.]\nWhat about true love..?

label: @talk
source:
Stop right there, Rocket!
Lance may no longer be Champion[.]\pBut it's still my job to guard
these Pokémon from people like you!\pI can see you're a formidable one[.]\pBut your authority in the Rocket
world means nothing to me!\pI can throw you in jail, no
problem! Get lost!

label: @text
source: It looks like somebody has pushed\nthis boulder aside already..!

label: @text
source: [player] opened the briefcase.\pInside was[.]\c\h08ó a sack of money!

label: @text2
source: [player] obtained [$]10,000!

label: @text3
source:
[.]\c\h08ó
A letter is attached.\p"Dear [player],\pI am not fit to lead Team Rocket
any longer.\pMy criminal dignity will not allow
it. I've failed you.\pBut you, [player][.]\c\h08ó You've grown
much stronger than any of us.\pAs a Pokémon Trainer there's not a
Rocket in Kanto who measures up.\pAnd your honor is still intact.\c\h08ó
So with my blessing[.]\pDo the things I should have done
long ago.\pGo westwards to the Indigo Plateau,
and take on the Elite Four.\pDeliver our revenge on Red[.]\c\h08ó
Lance[.]\c\h08ó and Oak.\pLeave Team Rocket a lasting legacy
in Kanto.\c\h08ó Let them remember us.\pUse our infamy to its fullest[.]\c\h08ó then
disband the organization for good.\p[.]\pThe contents of this briefcase are
yours to keep.\pI am giving you all the power and
prestige the criminal world has\lto offer.\pThe power to steal from Gym
Leaders, the Elite Four and the\lPokémon Champion.\pThis is to be your final promotion.\pRegards,\c\h08ó
